notes.title: Update 0.365 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.365[/b] is now available![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OKRjs94KprA;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]List of Update 0.365 Changes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Tiger Shark Special Operation and Mission Selection[/b][/p][p]We are happy to present the third mission of the Black Company Special Operation – Tiger Shark! In this mission, the Black Company will take on a notorious pirate warlord deep within his domain, on a pirate island in the Indian Ocean! Read more in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/now-available-special-operation-tiger-shark"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p]The Tiger Shark Special Operation also introduces the option for players to actually choose which mission from the Black Company series you want to play. Please note:[/p][list][*][p]To play Tiger Shark, new players must finish the two previous missions at least once[/p][/*][*][p]This mechanic is currently not available for other older Special Operation mission series[/p][/*][/list][p][b]African Contract[/b][/p][p]In this update, we’re adding a new contract replacing the old Basurmanin one. As usual, you are able to complete the contract missions in exchange for the following prizes:[/p][list][*][p]Olifant Mk.2 Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank for the initial contract completion[/p][/*][*][p]South African camouflage and decals available for contract achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Contract Loot Crate with various camouflages, temporary vehicles and other prizes for further completions[/p][/*][/list][p]As usual, the contract will last several months at least so there is plenty of time to finish it. You can read more about the vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/upcoming-contract-olifant-mk2"]dedicated article.[/url][/b] Please note, however, that the Olifant MBT is currently not in its final state and we are still working on fixing several issues tied to it.[/p][p][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the description of the Solo mission that also requires you to not die before the completion of the objective[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the maximum speed for the upgraded engine to 85 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302: Fixed the description of the Mitigation passive ability[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMP-3M: Fixed the infantry door visual model[/p][/*][*][p]VCAC Mephisto: Increased the ammunition carried to 60[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from completing a PvE (Heroic) mission in the "Contract from the Unknown 3" Battalion contract[/p][/*][*][p]Several localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Historical Skins: Leopard Evolution “Schweppermann”
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]We have recently shown you the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-german-winter-0"]new camouflages[/url][/b] we will have for you in the future but that’s not all the German-themed content we will have for you. We’ll also be introducing the [b]first skin for the Leopard Evolution Main Battle Tank called “Schweppermann.”[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c3b244ea9cc84b7e7cf1315fc7651d08185bd9bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now, we promised we’d continue with the topic of knights and here it is. This skin paints the Leopard 2 Evolution in Bundeswehr colors, including its camouflage and unit insignia. Now, the skin is obviously not based on a specific one vehicle because Leopard Evolution is not (and likely never will be) used by the Bundeswehr. It basically was an export configuration that would later be superseded by Leopard Revolution. However, the skin’s specific elements are taken from existing vehicles. Let’s take a look at them one by one.[/p][p]The camouflage is, of course, the standard NATO one. It entered service around 1986 (it therefore predates unified Germany) and consists of three basic colors – green, black and brown. However, as you can see, the tank features additional white stripes across its hull and turret. These stripes (also known as the “Zebra” camouflage) were seen on several Leopard 2 tanks belonging to the 304th Tank Battalion (Panzerbataillon 304) during winter exercises at Hohenfels in the January of 1996. According to the Germans, this pattern obscures the tank silhouette fairly well at around 2500 meters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6f4461b91048750682850afbc32c34e8244dc267.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The tank, however, does not belong to Panzerbataillon 304 – based on its insignia, it belongs to Panzerbataillon 33. This unit was using Leopard 2A4s (the Leopard Evolution is based on) in the early 1990s and was the first one to switch to the newer Leopard 2A5 model. Back then the unit belonged to the 1st Panzergrenadier Brigade (before its disbandment in 2007).[/p][p]The tactical number and the license plate also belong to a tank from the same unit, as does the unit emblem (a palm tree) on the left side of the turret and the knight image on its right side. This charging knight emblem was seen during the same exercise as the camouflage (Hohenfels, January 1996).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/495c5f4494787f1596d9d55f9bc9d6db5600ada2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The only truly unhistorical element is the tank’s name – Schweppermann. The name matches the knight emblem nicely, we thought, as Seyfried Schweppermann was a legendary 13th and 14th century German knight who served Emperor Ludwig IV. He was known not only for his piety and bravery, but also for fighting well into his 60s. The barracks of Panzerbataillon 123 are named after him (we’ll have a [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-camouflages-german-winter-0"]decal belonging to the unit as well[/url][/b]), bringing the reference to a full circle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d0c58650827eabcdb6ec0b2a564e9235e5ec3e4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s it, commanders. The skin will be available alongside the abovementioned camouflages and decals in October. We hope you’ll like it and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Historical Camouflages – German (Winter)
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]The summer’s technically not over yet but the weather says different and with it behind us, it’s time to take a look at some of our upcoming autumn content. For a future German-themed event, we’ve prepared new camouflages and decals for you. Let’s take a look at them together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f96582140e2c372edfa39a81a5cebc0a8609c841.png"][/img][/p][p]The first of our winter camouflages is called [b]German (134 Panzerbataillon).[/b] As its name suggests, this unusual (atypical) German camouflage was seen on a Leopard 1A1A2 belonging to the 134th Tank Battalion of the 13th Panzergrenadier Brigade during the Central Guardian exercise in the morning of January 21, 1985, in Ohmes near Kirtorf.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3941b67d667d305e86a9788a3974e1bba18bf768.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Central Guardian was a part of the wider REFORGER 85 exercise and the German goal of it was to train in poor weather conditions alongside the U.S. Army reinforcing NATO’s eastern flank. Indeed, it was a cold, snowy day in West Germany and the crew decided to paint their otherwise white-painted tank with irregular green lines to break its silhouette.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/251010d4570f4a46d6bc300b2ba5629acd2f87ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The second camouflage is considerably more modern. It’s called [b]German (Gebirgsjägerbrigade 23)[/b] and was seen on a Bandvagn 206 carrier belonging to the German 23rd Mountain Infantry Brigade during the Grand North exercise in Norway in the February and March of 2024.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3ed0b3642843e2a2d9e1217ad9b357c67d535c72.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The exercise was a part of the Quadriga 24 Bundeswehr exercise, the goal of which was once again training relocation and combat in poor weather with some 12000 German soldiers taking part in it.[/p][p]In addition to these camouflages, there will be three decals available, all three belonging to Bundeswehr tanks.[/p][p]The [b]Panzerbataillon 123 decal[/b] displays the knight helmet of Seyfried Schweppermann, a legendary German knight from the 14th century. It was seen during an exercise in 1990 on a Leopard 2 tank belonging to the 123rd Tank Battalion of the 12th Tank Brigade during an exercise.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5d94ca2f29712d8f58d8f05782e0e05671e0a1de.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You may know this emblem from the Leopard 2A4 Budeswehr skin that’s already available and belongs to the same unit. It was adopted by the unit in 1974 and it symbolizes the shock and awe power of armored, mobile troops – be it tanks today or knights in the Middle Ages. We’ll talk more about Seyfried Schweppermann in the future.[/p][p]The [b]Panzerbataillon 121 decal[/b] also carries medieval symbolism with it. It displays a knight sword in a yellow triangle and was seen on a Leopard 2 tank belonging to the 121st Tank Battalion of the 12th Tank Brigade during the same exercise. The color yellow is common for all emblems of this tank brigade.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1c49407715de207fe0c6cc602bf9a725c266ff52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The sword is double-edged, which actually has a meaning – it’s meant to symbolize that the tanks and panzergrenadiers (mechanized infantry) are two blades of the same sword.[/p][p]And, last but not least, the [b]Teutonic Knight decal[/b] showing a charging knight with a lance in the form of a machinegun barrel was seen relatively recently on a Leopard 2A6 tank belonging to the 203rd Tank Battalion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/66efdc894e9a8014d8ac60a743e6c622ededef49.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s it for now, but we’ll return to the topic of knights in the near future. We hope that you’ll enjoy the new assets and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.360 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.360[/b] is now available![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/90a635665c3c6108652766f6ecbaad593ce61a19.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.360 Changes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Premium Vehicles for Gold[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are adding the following Premium vehicles to the dealer trees. Alright, not just a little bit – we are looking at 65% PvP winrate, making it currently hands down the best vehicle in the game by a wide margin, which is something that has to be addressed.[/p][p align="start"]We are therefore making the following adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the Spall Liner module increasing the vehicle’s hitpoints[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Improved Transmission module increasing the vehicle’s maximum speed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the vehicle’s hitpoints to 3300[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the vehicle’s maximum speed to 85 km/h[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Mitigation ability damage reduction values from 50%/75%/90% to 40%/55%/70% (the ability still reduces module damage taken)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]In short, we removed two modules but improved the base values to compensate (even a bit beyond the bonus the modules provided) and reduced the damage reduction of the Mitigation ability (the speed thresholds remain the same). The vehicle will still be very powerful (we haven’t nerfed its firepower) but now won’t be all but unstoppable.[/p][p align="start"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]We (fingers crossed) fixed the issue plaguing the Battle Path Shop where players weren’t able to buy items due to the fact that what they see in the Shop is not what the server sees. Such desynchronizations should no longer occur[/p][/*][*][p]Rolling Thunder mission can no longer be completed using any vehicle and requires Light Tanks as intended[/p][/*][*][p]All MERDCS camouflages from the main progression are now correctly compensated (one was missing and we will send the missing Battle Coins to the affected players)[/p][/*][*][p]ELKE: Vehicle is now assigned to Oscar Faraday[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p align="start"]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the collision model of a number of vehicles (T-80B, Type 90-II, VFM5, ZBL-08, Assaulter, BMP-2M, BMP-3M, Challenger notes.title: Upcoming Contract: Olifant Mk.2
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]This autumn, we’ll be replacing the current set of Contract missions that allow you to receive the BMP-1AM Basurmanin AFV with a brand-new African contract that will feature a new prize – the [b]Olifant Mk.2 Main Battle Tank![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/da031d6506e1e0e0b16524edc010ea9a657373b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Olifant Mk.2 (Afrikaans for “Elephant”) is South Africa’s most advanced Main Battle Tank to date but, much like many other vehicles of the same class, it’s build on much older foundations. The Olifant is a heavily modified (and the final evolution of) the British Centurion MBT, the roots of which go back the final days of the Second World War.[/p][p]South Africa purchased some 200 Centurions Mk.3 from the United Kingdom in the early 1950s but they didn’t last long in service due to issues with maintenance constant overheating. In 1961, half of them were sold off to Switzerland and the other half was mothballed. However, with the threat of Angola rising in the mid-1970s, it was decided to bring them back.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f36fb38a1b05f843ca2d438e2a130b2010a54f08.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first Olifants (the Mk.1 version) appeared in the late 1970s. With the help of Israel, they were retrofitted with different engines and built upon imported hulls. The armament was local-made, however, making the Olifant the best indigenous African tank in history. The tank saw battle in 1987. During a single battle, South African Olifants destroyed two Angolan T-55 tanks.[/p][p]In the early 1990s, the Mk.1B version appeared with additional armor. The final Mk.2 version was designed with lessons from the Border War in mind. The initial requirements from 1998 called for 96 brand-new MBTs but with the existing budget restraints, it was decided to upgrade existing Olifant Mk.1B’s instead.[/p][p]The Mk.1B version already featured upgraded armor (in form of composite plates covering both the hull and the turret) and the Mk.2 added a new engine to the package along with a new fire control system governing the 105mm Denel GT3B gun.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dcfde57e3ea514c650c295f8f4e7d1229d9f521f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ultimately, only 25 vehicles of this type were built between 2005 and 2018. Still, the Olifant is a great example of what budget upgrades can accomplish. With gradual parts replacements over the decades, not much is left of the old Centurion.[/p][p][b]In Armored Warfare, the Olifant Mk.2 will be a Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank.[/b][/p][p]Overall, we are looking at a relatively well-protected Main Battle Tank for its Tier. Compared to Centurion AVRE, the main difference is of course the main gun, which, in this case, is a 105mm rifled cannon. As such, the Olifant will offer more consistent firepower compared to the AVRE, making it more suitable to prolonged engagements. The vehicle will feature a standard set of Tier-appropriate shells, including APFSDS, HESH and HE.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f74049857f71b356c3c8c54acc175b0282377352.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A unique element of this vehicle is the presence of smoke shells and white phosphorus shells. The Olifant will be able to fire these shells from its main gun, providing extra support on the battlefield.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a02546e02f34eef8b0925a603ceaccd3e049fa88.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While lacking ERA, the protection will also be excellent thanks to all that additional armor on its Centurion hull. Aiding in this regard will be the Defense unlockable active ability. notes.title: Garage (Re)Loaded: Welcome to the Battlefield! Second part.
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Whether you are rookies starting a fresh mercenary career, or grizzled veterans, here’s something that you might not want to miss out on. [b]From August 28 to September 11[/b], Armored Warfare’s hosting a very special event that will allow you to try all sorts of different vehicles for free and receive juicy bonuses to boot![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="g0U-A2OzC8I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]New Player Gift[/h2][p][/p][p]During this period, [b]newly registered accounts will automatically receive a special gift[/b], consisting of:[/p][list][*][p]IS-7 Tier 4 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]90 days of Premium Time[/p][/*][*][p]1.000 Gold[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Garage (Re)Loaded[/h2][p][/p][p]Additionally you’ll be able to [b]claim 70 temporary (3-day) Premium vehicles in our Web Shop and try them out.[/b][/p][p]They’ll be split into two batches – during the first week, you can claim 35 of these, and another 35 during the second week. The selection is wide – now’s the right time to sample which sort of gameplay suits you the most![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2b9290e710e4513ae8119caec91d9803da88dde9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After claiming them, these vehicles will appear as tokens [b]in your Inventory section[/b] and can be activated at any point in the future.[/p][p][b]Click on the button below to visit the Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=gift"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bonuses[/h2][p][/p][p]But that’s not all. For the duration of the event, [b]we’ve prepared a set of awesome bonuses![/b] These include:[/p][list][*][p]50% bonus to Battle Coin income from battles[/p][/*][*][p]30% bonus to Credit income from battles[/p][/*][*][p]30% bonus to Experience income from battles[/p][/*][*][p]30% bonus to Reputation income from battles[/p][/*][/list][p]This event represents a great opportunity for Armored Warfare beginners to unlock new vehicles faster than usual with the bonuses as well as to try out what playstyle and vehicle fits then the most.[/p][p][b]And as for you, dear veterans, enjoy the bonuses and don’t forget to share your hard-earn wisdom with the new guys. After all, nobody begins as an expert![/b][/p][p][b]Please note:[/b][/p][list][*][p]There are no compensations for claiming any of these vehicles (Inventory tokens are impossible to activate if you have the permanent version already)[/p][/*][*][p]To activate a temporary vehicle (after claiming it in the Web Shop), please visit your Inventory section of the Garage[/p][/*][*][p]In case you encounter an issue claiming the vehicles in the Web Shop (Error -1006), please wait 15 minutes and try again[/p][/*][*][p]Like what you see? If you play a temporary vehicle and later decide to obtain it permanently (by any means, including random drops, Contracts, Steam DLCs, Web Shop, Battle Path or as a prize from a Loot Crate), your progression (such as crew training) will carry over from the temporary version issued during this event[/p][/*][*][p]There is a known issue with some temporary vehicles having wrong icons, the vehicles themselves are however working as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Having issues claiming gifts with Error -1006? Please wait 15 minutes and try again![/p][/*][*][p]Items from Web Shop disappear after claiming them – look for your vehicle tokens in Inventory[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that you’ll enjoy the event an, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.355 Now Available
notes.content: [p]Commanders![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.355[/b] is now available![/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6a48b502a0c31b8a1b57effb074da7606f5ee542.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]List of Update 0.355 Changes[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Economy Changes[/b][/p][p align="start"]As a part of a revitalization of the entire economy of Armored Warfare in order to ensure the game’s longevity, we are making several changes to the game’s economy in regards to Credit income. The changes concern the First Victory of the Day bonus and are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Special Operations (Hardcore difficulty): from 300% bonus for Credits and XP (x4) once per 3 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 300% for XP (x4) once per 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Special Operations (Extreme difficulty): from 300% bonus for Credits and XP (x4) once per 3 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 300% for XP (x4) once per 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Special Operations (Heroic difficulty): from 900% bonus for Credits and XP (x10) once per 7 days to 200% bonus for Credits (x3) and 900% for XP (x10) once per 7 days[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We’ll continue keeping an eye on the Credit situation to make sure the changes have the desired effect.[/p][p align="start"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/p][p align="start"]In this update, we are fixing the following issues of the Rough Riders Battle Path and its vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Forest Green paint is no longer issued three times at Level 43 of the Battle Path[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Ares: Guns now show the correct characteristics in the Garage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p align="start"]With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:[/p][list][*][p]BMT-72-140: Improved main gun’s depression angles[/p][/*][*][p]Bradley FV: ATGMs no longer ignore launcher elevation and depression[/p][/*][*][p]Leclerc T4: Changed the vehicle’s short name in order for it to be consistent with other Leclerc tanks[/p][/*][*][p]Object 292: Replaced the Kaktus Generation 3 ERA with the intended Malakhit Generation 4 ERA[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Fixed several smaller visual issues with the Gromozeka skin[/p][/*][*][p]T-90A Burlak: Gromozeka skin no longer changes vehicle’s armor[/p][/*][*][p]TOS-1M Buratino: Fixed a bug where the aiming reticle was “jumping” when targeting TOS-1M in battle[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Deployable turret now also targets enemy infantry (but fires at vehicles with higher priority)[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Players can now correctly designate targets for the deployable turret (by pressing V, the same way as it works for Mechanized Infantry)[/p][/*][*][p]VN20: Deployable turret fire no longer damages your teammates with splash (shell explosion shockwave) damage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]General Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified the mission description for the Beasts of Steel event[/p][/*][*][p]Weekend Special Operation Loot Crates now have a correct description (they drop Rough Riders Battle Coins)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Starter Pack reward icons in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several Battalion Contract mission timers (for M1A2C, BMPT-72 and Challenger 2 Hades vehicles)[/p][/*][*][p]Investigated a number of issues causing the game to crash upon pressing the Reconnect button (an ongoing process)[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller localization fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a number of future event assets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: In Development: Special Operation “Tiger Shark”
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]It’s been some time since the last mission updated but we are happy that we can tell you more about the third part of the Black Company Special Operation series called [b]Tiger Shark.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/23459e597484801c8ff70b7aaff5ce3de16b775c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This mission continues the story of Joshua Seagrove and Kathryn Grey and their rise to fame as Black Company mercenaries. Upon the conclusion of the Lone Star mission, Port Houston is liberated from its occupation by Clayburn Industries.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7f972331db3593f3c2d55f9bd366f58ee0359932.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the aftermath of the events, Seagrove and Grey receive an offer from Suez Incorporated to save a ship hijacked by pirates and bringing it back in exchange for clearing their names of war crime accusations. Not willing to waste such an opportunity, they immediately set sail to a small island in the Indian Ocean.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1381f083a92570c70d53748f02cb55cd061a0eca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As the description above suggests, the mission will take place on a tropical island controlled by ruthless pirates. These criminals are led by Louis Pareil, a ruthless French ex-special forces operator-turned-warlord so you’ll be in for quite a fight. He has quite a few aces up his sleeve.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3cdfda07de3dd1fb5df934c65d44c8b528385d6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We carefully listened to your feedback and made two major changes to the design. First, the mission is shorter than the previous two so you’ll no longer spend an hour fighting every time you launch it. Second, starting with its introduction, it’ll be newly possible to select which mission you want to play of the three in the menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/96dea945b35cd0415d96ac040233445d62201000.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As always there will be mission-specific achievements with new rewards, including a pirate player avatar and a brand-new camouflage for three environments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/91b36df0e87340995520024b612843ac2c1e7164.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0e53c01255c7496c6767a41c45ec15de49f51625.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2ae8923245ada90894f4995635bce518ad689272.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/18e1484c4f0c2505ca7a90fb3684da1b9f8af763.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bbe9d66fb8830625116b50636b71300adadb8a52.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy this Special Operation that is coming to the game in early September and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p][p][/p]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d2b40b932bec0945b91136a4a8d534037f586912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path is now available!
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]We’re happy to announce that the [b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b] campaign has just begun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5Y1XaHcZOv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The Rough Riders Battle Path is focused on U.S. cavalry, from its humble beginnings in the Revolutionary War, the Civil War, the Rough Riders era of the late 19th century and both world wars to its transformation to the Armored Cavalry branch after the Vietnam War. The rewards will therefore be theme-appropriate, but there’s also a different theme at play here.[/p][p]There are 50 levels of waiting for you as usual. Let’s start with the vehicles:[/p][list][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-elke"]ELKE[/url][/b] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)[/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-rdflt-ares"]RDF/LT Ares[/url][/b] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)[/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm1302"]XM1302[/url][/b] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)[/p][/*][/list][p]There of course are new epic skins based on real-life vehicles, such as:[/p][list][*][p]M60A3 “Crustacean” for the M60A3[/p][/*][*][p]M3A2 Cavalry Vehicle for the M2 Bradley[/p][/*][*][p]IPM1 “Danger Zone” for the M1 Abrams[/p][/*][/list][p]Each comes with its unique story of U.S. service. New camouflages, decals and base paints will also come with this Battle Path.[/p][p]You can review the prizes in the [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-prize-highlights"]following article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Accessing the Battle Path[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In order to join the Battle Path campaign, please enter the game and click on the Rough Riders icon on the upper bar. From there, you can simply purchase the Battle Path access:[/p][list][*][p]Standard pass (access only)[/p][/*][*][p]Golden pass with access and 50.000 Battle Coins[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The access can also be purchased in our Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/web-shop?tags=bp"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Prize Highlights
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]The [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"]Rough Riders Battle Path[/url][/b] is coming in the second half of July and, as usual, we’d like to take a moment to tell you more about its prizes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dd1542c49fbbee061f50956a6be4a829c5351661.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you already know, the topic of this Battle Path is the history of U.S. light tanks – or, rather, the U.S. cavalry. As such, the Battle Path features numerous American-themed prizes, including vehicles and everything else. As usual, we have three [b]new Premium vehicles[/b] for you:[/p][list][*][p][b]ELKE[/b] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)[/p][/*][*][p][b]RDF/LT Ares[/b] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)[/p][/*][*][p][b]XM1302[/b] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/abf17dd73288fa95645f58bac1e1160f9461d754.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3ff234c608b85835c487c9de58af4fa38a8a892c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, you can earn the [b]following older vehicles[/b] by progressing down this Battle Path:[/p][list][*][p]T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Expeditionary LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][/list][p]It also has to be mentioned that the Light Tanks from the vehicle pool are getting buffed. You can learn more about that in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-light-tank-changes"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/42cc1369e13399a7b4feddf2f56d075d9ba70a23.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/042f133bfdd8f75b5022fb890ccb3d23a10ea3bb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ce09a20a91411fad97550f3132e74237d7d5d163.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a94f248b3dd57a8b86702c1b84465766d4ba2fa3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b4f38cde31b5a3c56a32e99259abf287dd1468f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You will also be able to earn the [b]MPF Tier 10 Premium Light Tank[/b] via blueprints available in the Battle Path Shop. The M10 Booker skin for it was also added to the Battle Path Shop pool.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/646df926659ad81e3cdbf80204a5a738af1553f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There is also a returning [b]Premium commander called Anthony Diaz[/b] for reaching Level 49. This rugged commander has a set of versatile skills that make him suitable for a lot of vehicles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c9ad85450f7d0f812db2f3f776f3c4ff8f77b715.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And last but not least, some of the most epic skins and camouflages are making a return as well, including (but not limited to):[/p][list][*][p]Full set of Prime skins[/p][/*][*][p]Freedom Rider skin[/p][/*][*][p]Ridgway skin for M8-120[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Rider skin for M60A3 SLEP[/p][/*][*][p]Gunslinger skin for the T249 Vigilante[/p][/*][*][p]Asgard skin for the M1A2[/p][/*][*][p]Vanguard skin for CATTB[/p][/*][*][p]Full set of MERDCS camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Reforger 83 camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Skins for the reward Light Tanks mentioned above (such as Acid and Reaper)[/p][/*][/list][p]Here are some of them:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/44c73596edc87de472e81b93adeb8eff8a9883c6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8d4054e8fec81790deaa3c489571920234555b62.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/77dab9f55edc521649c8b1d607302200c6acb099.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c13d223f706f73af8d676bfa70089ef7fbd30c67.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6f84d2d09e78063274c03ad1d18339ac3e818370.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d7b59cf972680ff65c80631e9af23c5662fc2ac2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But those are older prizes, what you want to see are some new ones, right? Let’s take a look at some of the new skins and camouflages that are coming in this Battle Path:[/p][p]This skin for the Bradley is called [b]M3A2 Cavalry Fighting Vehicle.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5abf2ad342141eca4ca673a461b5f6417a03c8df.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The M3 series of the Bradley platform is built for reconnaissance, carrying fewer troops and more ammunition and sensors instead. This particular Bradley belonged to the 1st Squadron of the 4th Cavalry Regiment, as seen in November 2004 during Operation Iraqi Freedom, the American invasion of Iraq.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cc358b9e00a0107c04db9b6d903d8ec72ae04073.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We chose the Bradley not only for its cavalry version, but also because it’s one of the best performing IFVs in the game currently. And to make things even better, we finally made Bradley’s launcher elevate and depress in battle. Take a look:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7ad6739a161c6311e29ff31007fbf2c35e931ff6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5eff68bc1967534cb94428a8cd1245eb5423bcf9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Next skin we have for you is called [b]IPM1 Danger Zone[/b] for the M1 Abrams MBT.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c99af31143d19cb29caac1a41442cdf8a955378c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The "Danger Zone" was an IPM1 Abrams participating in (and winning) the 1987 Canadian Army Trophy that took place in the Bergen-Hohne training area. It belonged to Company D of the 4th Squadron, 8th Cavalry Regiment, 3rd Armored Division in West Germany. It used a stylized version of the "Bill the Cat" cartoon as its emblem, which was an inside poke at one of its rivals, 3-64 Armor, who had been using the comic-strip cat Garfield as its mascot.[/p][p]Another major emblem was the "Spearhead" belonging to the 3rd Armored Division, located at the back of the turret. The flags on the vehicle were event-specific and were not used in regular service. The Canadian flag was in recognition of the close training between the team and the Royal Canadian Dragoons. And, last but not least, the name "Danger Zone" came from a popular song from the Top Gun movie.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/24c71c966021a462e91b77d48b3f8c73c6750f25.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, the skin converts the M1 into an IPM1 with its rear turret stowage.[/p][p]The third skin we have for you is called [b]M60A3 Crustacean.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f0bc50f3c2426afe3f4d21bffc8413ab4c03ae88.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The "Crustacean" was an M60A1 tank serving in Germany in the 1970s with the 73rd Armor Regiment. It was one of the vehicles selected to test the new camouflage patterns coming out of the MASSTER program in Fort Hood. The variant used on this particular vehicle used two primary colors – Rust Brown and Sand, each covering roughly 40 percent of the vehicle in wide areas. The rest was divided between Forest Green and Black colors. This camouflage appeared in 1973 and was used on multiple vehicles of the VII Corps. The emblem on the tank consisted of a stylized depiction of the Mk.VII Liberty tank from the First World War with a shell on top of it. The meaning of this emblem is unknown.[/p][p]While the original “Crustacean” was an M60A1, we decided to adapt the skin for the M60A3 Main Battle Tank as the M60A1 already has a nice historical skin (the USMC, also available via the Battle Path Shop or during events). The skin is available for both its configurations:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4574f4ae22faf039bf6b6f26979640cfb047deef.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As for the [b]camouflages, colors and decals[/b] – as we mentioned above, these follow the history of U.S. cavalry from the Revolutionary War and the American fight with the British.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/01003fd2b366c2985c760f050461ac7f29ad0888.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/306423f1b9e9fbef03bb168a2fecfaf4a3e8e7df.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Civil War was also a major milestone of the U.S. cavalry history with both sides relying on brilliant commanders and brave soldiers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/81384fcd57446e0a2af456f49c548072af5c6fcd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d4e6e625d08c16fb8d8a865e8f9c27db21f07b66.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then came the Rough Rider era and both World Wars that saw the cavalry change into a powerful mechanized force.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/aa85e94c2df8678b298b6a32e54cbe0cd94ca9fa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/57308a7ff20c1beddb6629fcbaf44a7bcef7bed0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Cold War saw the cavalry change again into an Air Cavalry branch with helicopters and Armored Cavalry with heavy vehicles, including tanks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/30e702d7e3cc16faad3bdbf4a019943aabfe5a12.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And even after the fall of the Soviet Union, America’s greatest adversary, the cavalry units continue to uphold their traditions as a new threat rises to challenge the most powerful military the world has ever seen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f95bf9af89a88439717fb54ff4335ee2b7663b7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This and much more is waiting for you in the Rough Riders Battle Path. We hope that you’ll enjoy this event and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

tags.feature: - As usual, we have three [b]new Premium vehicles[/b] for you:
- [b]ELKE[/b] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)
- [b]RDF/LT Ares[/b] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)
- [b]XM1302[/b] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)
Additionally, you can earn the [b]following older vehicles[/b] by progressing down this Battle Path:
- T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank
- RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank
- M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank
- Expeditionary LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank
- Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank
You will also be able to earn the [b]MPF Tier 10 Premium Light Tank[/b] via blueprints available in the Battle Path Shop. The M10 Booker skin for it was also added to the Battle Path Shop pool.
There is also a returning [b]Premium commander called Anthony Diaz[/b] for reaching Level 49. This rugged commander has a set of versatile skills that make him suitable for a lot of vehicles.
And last but not least, some of the most epic skins and camouflages are making a return as well, including (but not limited to):
- Full set of Prime skins
- Freedom Rider skin
- Ridgway skin for M8-120
- Rough Rider skin for M60A3 SLEP
- Gunslinger skin for the T249 Vigilante
- Asgard skin for the M1A2
- Vanguard skin for CATTB
- Full set of MERDCS camouflages
- Reforger 83 camouflages
- Skins for the reward Light Tanks mentioned above (such as Acid and Reaper)
But those are older prizes, what you want to see are some new ones, right? Let’s take a look at some of the new skins and camouflages that are coming in this Battle Path:
This skin for the Bradley is called [b]M3A2 Cavalry Fighting Vehicle.[/b]

We chose the Bradley not only for its cavalry version, but also because it’s one of the best performing IFVs in the game currently. And to make things even better, we finally made Bradley’s launcher elevate and depress in battle. Take a look:
Next skin we have for you is called [b]IPM1 Danger Zone[/b] for the M1 Abrams MBT.
The third skin we have for you is called [b]M60A3 Crustacean.[/b]
As for the [b]camouflages, colors and decals[/b] – as we mentioned above, these follow the history of U.S. cavalry from the Revolutionary War and the American fight with the British.
The Civil War was also a major milestone of the U.S. cavalry history with both sides relying on brilliant commanders and brave soldiers.
Then came the Rough Rider era and both World Wars that saw the cavalry change into a powerful mechanized force.
The Cold War saw the cavalry change again into an Air Cavalry branch with helicopters and Armored Cavalry with heavy vehicles, including tanks.

And even after the fall of the Soviet Union, America’s greatest adversary, the cavalry units continue to uphold their traditions as a new threat rises to challenge the most powerful military the world has ever seen.
This and much more is waiting for you in the Rough Riders Battle Path. We hope that you’ll enjoy this event and, as always:

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Improvements
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]In our previous articles, we have discussed the [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-info-and-preorder"][b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b][/url] and its [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/rough-riders-battle-path-economy"][b]economy[/b][/url] and other improvements, such as the [url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/developer-diary-light-tank-changes"][b]upcoming buffs of the Light Tank class[/b][/url]. But we have also been gathering your feedback and today we’d like to tell you more about the improvements we are making to the upcoming event.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dd1542c49fbbee061f50956a6be4a829c5351661.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First and foremost, we are adding a new vehicle prize to the event. [b]Griffin 120mm will be obtainable upon reaching Level 43.[/b] The Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank is an excellent vehicle in its class and represents a powerful addition to your arsenal. It is a powerful, fast machine, armed not only with its 120mm cannon, but also with special ammunition types, making it deadly at any distance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/42cc1369e13399a7b4feddf2f56d075d9ba70a23.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And if you have it already? That’s right, that’s another item you will receive bonus Battle Coins for. Jut to recap, the Battle Path now contains the following vehicle prizes:[/p][list][*][p]ELKE Tier 7 Premium Light Tank (new)[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Ares Tier 8 Premium Light Tank (new)[/p][/*][*][p]XM1302 Tier 10 Premium Light Tank (new)[/p][/*][*][p]T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Expeditionary LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Griffin 120mm Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][/list][p]The other prizes such as skins will be unveiled soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/abf17dd73288fa95645f58bac1e1160f9461d754.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3ff234c608b85835c487c9de58af4fa38a8a892c.jpg"][/img]Furthermore, we decided to make an [b]improvement to the Cavalry Blues camouflage.[/b] While blue by default, the camouflage will be able to change colors based on the base paint you use. Please note that the camouflage is pre-order exclusive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fe9536c9ed2c9ecea954f2028515dca81046ddae.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/93d2fad23564c77e9b231b9056d5d375df6d2f86.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Next, we are [b]increasing the amount of Battle Coins available from completing Battle Path chain missions from 20000 to 35000.[/b][/p][p]As announced earlier, the missions will require Tier 3 to Tier 10 Light Tanks, so make sure you stock up on those – or you can earn them as you progress through the Battle Path.[/p][p]And last but definitely not least, we are [b]adding a large number of items to the Battle Path shop[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]New MPF blueprints in the blueprint slot of the Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Commanders Seagrove and Grey make a return[/p][/*][*][p]13 new or returning vehicles (including Ajax, EMBT, Typhoon-VDV, XM2001 Crusader, M2020, VN20 and XK3)[/p][/*][*][p]18 new skins (including the Honey Badger, M1A3 Aces, T-14 with Nakidka, Koschei the Deathless and M10 Booker)[/p][/*][*][p]Over 50 new camouflages from the previous 5 Battle Paths[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Battle Path is now available for pre-order. The bundles are available in our Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p]
[url=https://arwar.co/3TeRle6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]
We hope you will enjoy these improvements and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Offer: Kornet-D1, Object 195 and Object 490
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today we’ve prepared the following items for you:[/p][list][*][p]Object 490 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Object 195 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Kornet-D1 Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Between June 17 and June 24, 2025[/b], the following items will be available:[/p][p][/p][h2]Object 490[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 490 Main Battle Tank was an advanced concept from the waning days of the Soviet Union. Designed in the 1980s, it represented a radical departure from the MBT paradigm. Its distinct wedge-like shape, along with the fact that the crew was located in the back, offered unparalleled levels of protection. But the most interesting part of the design was its double suspension paired with two engines, allowing the vehicle to stay mobile even after suffering significant damage. However, the conclusion of the Cold War put an end to this design, along with many other advanced Soviet projects. You can learn more about this vehicle in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-490"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object490_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 490 Tier 10 Premium MBT is perhaps the best armored vehicle in the game. It’s a true behemoth that is almost impossible to slow down, let alone knock out, and concentrated effort is required to stop one of these things when encountering them on the battlefield. The combination of extremely thick armor and a powerful 152mm gun makes this tank incredibly deadly, even though these advantages are balanced by its mediocre agility and the fact that its gun is only forward facing. This MBT is ideal for you if you prefer slow, methodical advances while dealing massive amounts of damage with each shot. If you keep your flanks secure, you’ll be all but impossible to stop.[/p][p]The Object 490 MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Object 195[/h2][p][/p][p]The Object 195 Main Battle Tank is one of the 1980s Soviet supertanks, intended to fight the next generation of NATO MBTs. It was developed in Nizhny Tagil by the experienced Uralvagonzavod design bureau (UKBTM), which was responsible for such legendary tanks as the T-72 and T-90. Much like other such prototypes, it was designed to be armed with massive 152mm smoothbore cannon in an unmanned turret. A single prototype was built and it allegedly passed state trials between 2008 and 2010 but the project was discontinued due to a lack of financing. You can learn more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-195"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/object195_webshop_1920x1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Object 195 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank and one of the most versatile vehicles you can get your hands on thanks to a combination of excellent armor, unmanned turret, 152mm hard-hitting gun and one special feature – the coaxial 30mm autocannon that allows you to take out unarmored targets without having to waste a shot of your main weapon.[/p][p]The Object 195 Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Kornet-D1[/h2][p][/p][p]The Kornet-D1 Tank Destroyer was one of the proposed variants for the BMD-4M chassis. As a dedicated tank hunter, it was supposed to be armed with two Kornet ATGM quad launchers, providing the Russian Airborne forces with long-range tank-killing capabilities. The project was launched in 2013 but the vehicle never reached the prototype stage with the program likely being canceled in 2018. You can read more about it in our [b][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kornet-d1"]dedicated article.[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920x1080_1_58.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Armored Warfare, the Kornet-D1 is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer and a tracked counterpart to the wheeled Kornet-EM progression vehicle. It is only lightly armed but also very stealthy and its lack of vision range is compensated by the ability to deploy a Sniper. Additionally, when configured properly, the vehicle is capable of launching two missiles at once, making it incredibly deadly against any target, especially at long ranges.[/p][p]This vehicle is available via Loot Crates, which drop Kornet-D1 parts. Collect 100 Kornet-D1 parts from these Loot Crates to assemble the whole vehicle.[/p][p][b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=loot"][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: Rough Riders Battle Path: Info and Preorder
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]Today, we’d like to tell you more about the upcoming [b]Rough Riders Battle Path[/b] campaign as a whole along with the changes and improvements we’ve prepared for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/61acf638d4c02451933f3bb9153fb641beb25884.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Preorder[/h2][p][/p][p]You can now secure the access to the Battle Path early (and with preorder-exclusive items) in the Web Shop “Battle Path” section. The following bundles are available:[/p][list][*][p]Rough Riders access with the Cavalry Blues camouflage and the Modern Cavalryman player avatar[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Riders access with 50.000 Battle Coins, the Cavalry Blues camouflage and the Modern Cavalryman player avatar[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Riders access with 10 Battle Coin boosters, the Cavalry Blues camouflage and the Modern Cavalryman player avatar[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note that the access price in Gold will increase from 3.999 Gold to 5.999 Gold at the launch of the event. However, the compensation for receiving the access multiple times remains 3.999 Gold for all such cases.[/b][/p][p]The camouflage gives your vehicle a subtle rusty, worn-look only acquired by long years of service. If you’re not into flamboyant patterns, this is the right camouflage for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9e705f039d8e14346ca0097c4f0d669aa09ea30e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For more details about the Rough Riders Battle Path, please read below.[/p][p][b]The bundles are available in our Web Shop:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://armoredwarfare.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/12651_bs_aw_webshopicon_429x154.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Rough Riders[/h2][p][/p][p]The Rough Riders Battle Path is focused on U.S. cavalry, from its humble beginnings in the Revolutionary War, the Civil War, the Rough Riders era of the late 19th century and both world wars to its transformation to the Armored Cavalry branch after the Vietnam War. The rewards will therefore be theme-appropriate, but there’s also a different theme at play here.[/p][p]There will be 50 levels of waiting for you as usual. Let’s start with the vehicles:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-elke"][b]ELKE[/b][/url] Tier 7 Premium LT for reaching Level 20 (featuring an elevated weapons station allowing you to ambush your enemies with ease)[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-rdflt-ares"][b]RDF/LT Ares[/b][/url] Tier 8 Premium LT for reaching Level 35 (featuring powerful missile launchers as well as 75mm gun)[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xm1302"][b]XM1302[/b][/url] Tier 10 Premium LT for reaching Level 50 (featuring new “Mitigation” passive ability – the faster you go, the less damage you take)[/p][/*][/list][p]There will of course be new epic skins based on real-life vehicles, such as:[/p][list][*][p]M60A3 “Crustacean” for the M60A3[/p][/*][*][p]M3A2 Cavalry Vehicle for the M2 Bradley[/p][/*][*][p]IPM1 “Danger Zone” for the M1 Abrams[/p][/*][/list][p]Each comes with its unique story of U.S. service. New camouflages, decals and base paints will also come with this Battle Path.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/eaa740391fa5fed162963ad8ba917c3570389467.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]However, there’s also a major change that’s new with this Battle Path because it will allow you to [b]earn previously released content as well as new.[/b][/p][p]This content includes several new Premium vehicles, epic American skins and more. Here are a few examples of items you will also earn:[/p][list][*][p]T92 ACAV Tier 2 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]M60A3 SLEP Tier 6 Premium Main Battle Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Expeditionary LT Tier 8 Premium Light Tank[/p][/*][*][p]Full set of Prime skins[/p][/*][*][p]Freedom Rider skin[/p][/*][*][p]Ridgway skin for M8-120[/p][/*][*][p]Rough Rider skin for M60A3 SLEP[/p][/*][*][p]Gunslinger skin for the T249 Vigilante[/p][/*][*][p]Full set of MERDCS camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Reforger 83 camouflages[/p][/*][*][p]Skins for the reward Light Tanks mentioned above (such as Acid and Reaper)[/p][/*][/list][p]And much more. And if you are worried about the performance of your new Light Tanks – don’t be. They will be receive a [b]comprehensible buff[/b] along with the release of the Battle Path. If you own any of these rewards already, you’ll receive Battle Coins instead, making your progression through the Battle Path faster.[/p][p]But that is still not all. After all, what would a Battle Path be without a commander? [b]Commander Anthony Diaz[/b] will be making an appearance after nearly a decade of exile. You may have forgotten him but he has not forgotten you! This rugged commander has a set of versatile skills that make him suitable for a lot of vehicles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/6196451db7d883aa345f66e8769f18d3aaeeef09.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There are a few players who acquired his services in the past. To recognize their long service, these players will be rewarded with a lot of Battle Coins if they own Anthony Diaz.[/p][p][/p][h2]What else is new?[/h2][p][/p][p]The missions have been overhauled once again. This time, the missions will require Light Tanks, so better stock up on those – or use those you acquire from the Battle Path, they should perform fine in their new upgraded forms. Instead of high-stakes challenges, the missions have become a source of additional Battle Path boosters, Battle Coins and other goodies (and are therefore easier to complete than before).[/p][p]And, last but not least, we have added a couple of things to the Battle Path shop as usual – for the standardized prizes, of course. The rest of the Battle Path remains mostly the same. The Battle Path is currently planned to launch in the second half of July but, as usual, the specific date will be announced a bit later. We hope you’ll enjoy this Battle Path as much as we enjoyed designing it and, as always:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p]

notes.title: In Development: XM1302
notes.content:
[p]Commanders![/p][p]With the information of the first two Rough Riders Battle Path vehicles (ELKE, RDF/LT Ares) out in the open, it’s time to take a look at the final prize of the event, the [b]XM1302 Light Tank.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/19465d44e8fad9a927377ec2b8ac9fe8567f0ea7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But, as usual, a little history first.[/p][p]The XM1302 Light Tank prototype was developed by BAE to participate in the Mobile Protected Firepower (MPF) program, which was a U.S. Army program to replace the aging Stryker platform. U.S. Airborne forces needed a highly mobile fire support platform, which effectively called for a reincarnation of the old Light Tank concept that had ended in active service with the M551 Sheridan.[/p][p]Two companies answered the call – BAE Land Systems with its prototype based on the old M8 Thunderbolt II Light Tank, and General Dynamics with a Light Tank based on the Griffin demonstrator. The first was the XM1302. The first iteration of this final incarnation of the M8 appeared in 2015 and was gradually upgraded until the launch of the MPF program in 2019. Twelve prototypes were in February 2021 and were thoroughly tested that year but, despite showing some quality, BAE was disqualified from the program in March 2022. Some say that the game was rigged from the start in GDLS's favor but regardless of how things went down, that was the end of XM1302.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/12b5e99b3d48f2efef1c4dcafec20d81277986ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The fate of all prototypes is unknown but at least one ended up in the U.S. Army Armor & Cavalry Collection museum in Fort Moore. The winning proposal by GDLS was renamed to M10C Booker and went on to be initially approved for mass production, only to be unceremoniously cancelled in 2025, once again leaving the U.S. Army without a highly mobile Light Tank the third or fourth time around. Time really is a flat circle.[/p][p][b]In Armored Warfare, the XM1302 will become a Tier 10 Premium Light Tank and the third and final new vehicle prize of the Rough Riders Battle Path.[/b][/p][p]Those of you familiar Armored Warfare’s many vehicles will likely immediately draw comparison to the MPF. That’s right; the current MPF Tier 10 Premium Light Tank was the competing project that became the M10C Booker. However, while meeting the same requirements and therefore being similar to one another in real life, these vehicles couldn’t be different in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cef001d4b0a9a8481059d5bb9e08c4b63310f2c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The MPF in the game is one of the heaviest Light Tanks around and is protected by layers of NERA. The XM1302 is effectively the opposite. We modeled the basic configuration without additional armor (which can be seen on most photos) and, instead of protection, we made it about speed.[/p][p]But let’s get the armor out of the way first. The vehicle has basic armor and that’s about it. Its protection lies in its special ability (described below), mobility, and the Iron Fist active protection system mounted on its turret with the Supercharged APS ability available. The APS, while not present on the real-life prototype, is quite realistic as it could be found on earlier BAE prototypes). The smoke grenade launcher is also improved compared to other vehicles of its class.[/p][p]The main weapon is the 105mm M35 soft recoil cannon that can be found on the XM8. The main difference is its ability to deal a lot of damage in a short period of time thanks to it having a large magazine and a very high rate of fire when it’s loaded. Granted, you won’t be penetrating most MBTs in their upper frontal plate, but that’s not how you are intended to play anyway. The gun will also offer excellent depression and elevation angles (-13/+20) so the vehicle will be easy and convenient to use.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fc0de564f600f3b254ee1884e0442ef5f1975d6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But the main point is its mobility. The XM1302 will be very fast and agile – that’s a given as its lack of armor needs to be compensated somehow. However, there’s one more trick to it. The XM1302 will offer a special [b]new passive ability called Mitigation.[/b][/p][p]Very simply put, the faster the tank goes, the less damage it takes. The current work looks roughly as such:[/p][list][*][p]If you are going 32 km/h (or faster) upon shell impact, you receive only 50% damage[/p][/*][*][p]If you are going 50 km/h (or faster, almost at maximum off-road speed) upon shell impact, you receive only 25% damage[/p][/*][*][p]If you are going 70 km/h (almost at maximum speed) upon shell impact, you receive only 10% damage[/p][/*][/list][p]There are of course downsides to this ability as well. For one, the mitigation does not affect module damage so it’s perfectly possible to become immobilized. Damage dealt by ramming and fires is not mitigated either. And last but not least, the numbers above are not final yet, we are still in the process of implementing the ability and it will require additional testing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/089fb8e5b4b2d4cbf927e4ee061dbe7368658af2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s still not everything. Owning this vehicle will be very useful because it’ll become a prerequisite to owning ANOTHER vehicle in an unannounced upcoming system, but it’s too early to talk about that. For now, please take the vehicle “as described above”.[/p][p]We hope you will enjoy this amazing machine as much as we enjoyed making it for you. We’ll tell you more about the rest of the Battle Path in the very near future, but for now:[/p][p][b]See you on the battlefield![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: In Development: RDF/LT Ares
notes.content:
Commanders!

On Monday, we revealed the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-elke]first article[/url] of the upcoming Rough Riders Battle Path and now we’re ready to show you the second one. Please welcome the RDF/LT Ares Light Tank prototype!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8b5130b944d869c4daae9560743d64e1171a481f.jpg[/img]

But, as usual, a little history first.

Since the days of the Vietnam War until the mid-1990s, the standard American light tank was the M551 Sheridan. As light tanks go, it was mediocre at best and with its problematic Vietnam record, it’s no wonder that the U.S. Army started to look for replacement.

The RDF/LT (Rapid Deployment Force Light Tank) was one of such designs by AAI Corporation. It originated in an earlier Light Tank program that went nowhere (as usual), but the lessons learned allowed AAI to develop this tank in hope of further participation in the U.S. Marine AVCT program. The Marines needed something fast with a lot of firepower but at the same time light enough to be transported using a sling under a CH-53 helicopter. The original prototype AAI produced was armed with a 75mm Ares cannon but realizing its experimental nature, AAI opted to replace it with an older, well-tested 76mm M32 rifled gun that had been previously used on the M41 Walker Bulldog Light Tank. Despite this, the result was quite an advanced and fast vehicle with its hull made of aluminum and even the gun received new APFSDS shells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7f19ff326f04eb3d2784d159ff78c8acd4cecf29.jpg[/img]

Regardless, despite these qualities, the Marines didn’t want it and that was the end of the RDF/LT. The end of the 1970s wasn’t really a good time for experimental projects with the funding being cut left and right as an aftermath of the lost Vietnam War. And so the Marines went for the LAV and HMMWV wheeled vehicles instead, leaving the RDF/LT in prototype stage only. The project was officially terminated in 1985.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/88eedd51b689343873cde64887c64fac650035b2.jpg[/img]

This RDF version is equipped with an unmanned turret (reducing the crew to two men) and Stinger missile pods to provide the vehicle with anti-air capabilities. This configuration appeared in a full-scale mock-up version.

[b]In Armored Warfare, the RDF/LT Ares will become a Tier 8 Premium Light Tank and the second prize of the Rough Riders Battle Path.[/b]

Performance-wise, we’re looking at something similar to the previously unveiled ELKE – an extremely mobile light tank with poor protection, armed with 75mm rapid-firing cannon with more advanced shells than used on the ELKE and a larger magazine – up to 18 shells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4e0fc46ee0d0d466e530bed1f5c165b6a07e2f74.jpg[/img]

However, there will be some notable differences. For one, the turret is unmanned, which means the vehicle won’t be as vulnerable as the ELKE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4abb94e737eda170fcda15d6b52ddc41b6db7ccf.jpg[/img]

As you can also see from the images, the vehicle is armed with ATGM launchers. In real-life, they fire Stinger SAMs. Our version fires Starstreaks, which are theoretically compatible with the launcher platform. The Stingers are also implemented – as potent thermobaric warhead missiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9b670aed02e802e03fc668135c73d46c3821531b.jpg[/img]

And, last but not least, the vehicle has an even more powerful engine and will therefore be even more suitable for the fast and hard-hitting gameplay Light Tanks are intended for. Overall, this tank will offer more tactical options than the ELKE because its missiles clearly are a long distance weapon system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0eca95cedc44a7d56a7f44c1346f2c55e9c7f429.jpg[/img]

However, the core will remain the same – to be perhaps the ultimate Light Tank of its Tier.

We hope that you’ll enjoy this vehicle and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Historical Skins: AbramsX Reaver
notes.content:
Commanders!

It wouldn’t be a U.S. Independence Day celebration without new American content and this year’s no exception. However, you might now be thinking, why take a look at it right now when we’re three days into June? Well, there’s a good reason for that, which we’ll explain below. Right now, we’re happy to introduce the newest skin that we will have for you – the [b]Reaver for AbramsX[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a6ce4cc8460b27f1992bb18d6c79e1bf7a947509.png[/img]

Considering the vehicle choice, the skin is not exactly historical in the truest sense of the word. Rather, it is inspired by real vehicles and revolves around a specific theme:

“What would happen if the AbramsX prototype was adopted in U.S. service?”

This particular AbramsX, named “Reaver” by its crew, clearly served in some middle-eastern country.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f2101bd22e367dad1e858671df0f632f71df979c.jpg[/img]

It’s been painted with the same sand color as other American MBTs but the surface is scratched and worn by heavy use. The crew’s belongings are lying on the back of the turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e038a500ff63b1d27a460786479e7adecb2b8920.jpg[/img]

We’ve paid extra attention to detail to make the skin look as realistic as possible and we hope you’ll enjoy it. But that’s not all we’ll have for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8ae16f8cdb5e49dd41ac37d0e41d571a972a7042.jpg[/img]

For the lovers of realism we have a new camouflage from the [b]Reforger 83[/b] family. notes.title: In Development: ELKE
notes.content:
Commanders!

With the current Battle Path in its second half, we’d like to show you what comes after you are finished with the history of mercenaries. The next Battle Path will be called Rough Riders and will focus on the history of U.S. cavalry, from its humble beginnings during the Revolutionary War to its transformation into the armored cavalry it is today. And the first vehicle of the Battle Path will be none other than the [b]ELKE technology demonstrator[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/dde16a4557253b6ec49c0093cd67ec2016a9f066.png[/img]

The ELKE is a part of the late 1970s and early 1980s search for a Sheridan replacement, which started with the HSTV-L and included the RDF and DFSV prototypes.

The word ELKE stands for Elevated Kinetic Energy. Following the dismissal of the early replacements to the Sheridan (the HSTV-L program), Pacific Car and Foundry was tasked in 1982 to produce a single prototype of their proposed elevated gun design using a Sheridan hull.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e404cd26885bf90eee69bb34d274d77e9cbabff7.jpg[/img]

The 75mm XM274 Ares gun would depress and elevate on a hydraulic-controlled arm, producing amazing elevation and depression angles. The Ares gun was a prototype of hypervelocity medium caliber cannon featuring penetration values similar to main caliber tank guns – at a fraction of their weight. Additionally, it was envisaged to have a very high rate of fire. The gun would be magazine-fed and the whole prototype weighed mere 15 tons.

Unfortunately, while impressive, the arm design was deemed much too unreliable. Another major issue of these designs was the limited amount of ammunition carried (far below the military requirements). As such, the prototype did not go anywhere but paved the way for the RDF Light Tank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d4720e41e6be279836d33755c9d11593817aa90b.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] In Armored Warfare, the ELKE will become a Tier 7 Premium Light Tank and the first prize of the Rough Riders Battle Path.
[/list]

For its Tier, the ELKE will be the ultimate Light Tank with unparalleled mobility and firepower. The downside? Nearly complete lack of armor, although most of the elevated weapons station does count as a weapons module rather than a turret.

But this tank won’t be about armor. It will be the embodiment of speed and precision as, for its mere 15 tons, it’ll use a 300hp engine (with 400hp being available through additional progression). The gun will feature a unique animation based on our analysis of the ELKE drawings and the few photographs that are available, allowing for extreme depression and elevation angles (-40/+25 degrees).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/122c13ce7da8e68c3efbbaf7861d4d23e5b752c7.jpg[/img]

The 75mm gun caliber lower damage will be compensated by extremely high rate of fire in two modes:

[list]
[*]     Rapid burst mode (6 round magazine) with a longer reload (upgradable to 12 rounds)
[*]     Regular fire mode (60 rounds per minute) (potentially upgradable to automatic, autocannon-like fire)
[/list]

And what’s the right tactic for what is essentially an armored and armed race car? Go in with the gun blazing, of course! For those who love unrivalled firepower and speed, this will be one of the most purist vehicles in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/50b5e23489ffe5e8699b7e8d8b0e9e97095cbeb7.jpg[/img]

On the other hand, its high-positioned cannon along with its gun depression will allow for some creative use of terrain when planning ambushes. Either way, the ELKE will devastate softer targets in seconds – you don’t want to find yourselves on the wrong side of that gun.

We hope that you’ll enjoy the ELKE as well as the entire Battle Path and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: In Development: Object 292
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today, we’d like to tell you about the Soviet Object 292 MBT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4d25c22a2987a45c305cd1e127d9c25f93187042.jpg[/img]
Object 292 model

As usual, let’s have a bit of history first. Object 292 was a late Soviet era “supertank” that was intended to fight the next generation of NATO MBTs. It was designed as an improved variant of the T-80 series MBT by the Kirov Plant in Leningrad (St. Petersburg).

You might be familiar with an overhauled T-80BV MBT with the 152mm 2A73 gun but that was not the “true” Object 292 – much like the Black Eagle “prototype”, it was just a testbed (in this case for the gun). It was developed in 1990 to see whether the 152mm gun could fit into the T-80B turret. It could (with some adjustments) and the vehicle underwent extensive trials in 1991 in Rzhev.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/498a1878da5bef66cf5fe698d75ac315212e06b1.jpg[/img]
Object 292 (T-80B testbed)

The tests have confirmed that the gun represented a major improvement of firepower compared to the standard 125mm 2A46 smoothbore series, including a 50 percent increase of muzzle energy. At the same time, due to its advanced construction, the gun had roughly the same recoil as the 2A46, allowing it to be installed into existing Soviet tanks. The chassis of the vehicle was stable and the vehicle performed well. At the same time, another welded turret was developed and it was this new variant that was to be used on the T-80U chassis and it is this combination we’re introducing.

This Object 292 variant (also known as “T-80U tank with LP-83 gun” or sometimes “T-80M”) isn’t super-well documented but it did exist in the form of drawing and several models. In this configuration, the tank weighed roughly 46 tons and had a crew of three men.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/54caeffa1e9ee44ed592487f377361305b2442af.png[/img]
T-80U tank with LP-83 gun

The tank was well-armored, the protection levels of the turret were analogical to the T-80U MBT with the ERA kit being upgradeable from the usual Kontakt-5 to Malakhit (a precursor to the current Relikt system). The tank was to be fitted with two active protection systems:

[list]
[*]     Shtora-1M soft-kill APS (connected to new 3D17 Purga-2 or 3D17M Purga-2M smoke grenades instead of the usual 902B Tucha system)
[*]     Drozd-2 hard-kill APS
[/list]

The status of the tank was monitored by a new control system called Barsuk-2.

The armament consisted mainly of the abovementioned 152mm 2A73 cannon (factory designation LP-83). The gun would be automatically loaded from a large carousel beneath the turret and a bustle-mounted charge storage (with blow-out panels). The vehicle carried 30 two-piece rounds, 16 of which were ready in the autoloader magazine. The gun fired the following shells:

[list]
[*]     Grifel-1 APFSDS with Tungsten core
[*]     Grifel-2 APFSDS with Depleted Uranium core
[*]     Grifel-3 HE-FRAG
[*]     Zaraysk APFSDS (the name also belongs to the research project of the LP-83 gun, performance unknown)
[*]     Sprinter ATGM with a tandem HEAT warhead
[/list]

The weapon was controlled by the 1A45M FCS featuring the DVE-BS wind sensor, 1G46M optics and either the older Buran-M night sights or the Agava-2T thermal imager. The commander had T01-K04 Agat-M optics at his disposal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f63fcb9fb1437cec55405f410fb6159cc66ecbe1.jpg[/img]
Object 292 model

The tank was powered by the GTD-1250 1250hp gas turbine engine (or even the then-developed 1500hp GTD-1500G engine), allowing it to go as fast as 70 km/h.

In short, it was to be a beast. However, with the breakup of the Soviet Union and the major budget cuts that followed, the vehicle was never really developed into a production variant. Its prototype had stayed abandoned for years until it was moved to the Kubinka tank museum and restored.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c02db86d0c949276ed450116aaf7a49b15a535f5.jpg[/img]

[b]In Armored Warfare, the Object 292 will be a Marat Shishkin Tier 10 Main Battle Tank.[/b]

We had several options as to what to put on Tier 10 of the branch but this vehicle seemed like the most natural choice, especially when we decided not to just go with a T-80B with a different gun but an entirely new turret. We also debated the name but in the end, we felt that Object 292 is the best-known option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9bffa7d838c5a00467f009d98290d3cc3d604fc3.jpg[/img]

Gameplay-wise, we’re once again looking at a rather conventional vehicle with the gameplay similar to that of the Tier 7 T-80U MBT. The vehicle will be relatively difficult to destroy due to its compact size, fast, and hard-hitting, although the protection levels will perhaps not be the best of its Tier. After all, it’s a three-decades-old piece of technology. It’ll be best suited for players who like a lot of mobility and firepower without sacrificing too much protection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/68a6390d278ac37630db1cde858aa9856cd3483e.jpg[/img]

There are two more things you should know, commanders. First is the vehicle’s special feature in the form of a new Supercharged APS ability that combines the functionality of hard-kill and soft-kill APS. In short, this ability works as if you activated Supercharged soft-kill APS and Supercharged hard-kill APS at the same time.

The second thing is that unlocking the vehicle will require you to complete an achievement using the T-80BVM Tier 9 MBT. The achievement requires you to gather 2500000 points where:

[list]
[*]     Each damage point counts as 1 (5 in PvP)
[*]     Each kill counts as 200 (1000 in PvP)
[*]     Extra 2500 points are awarded for victory (5000 in PvP)
[*]     Extra 1750 points are awarded for survival (3500 in PvP)
[/list]

Survival in terms of PvE means that you must not die throughout the mission. Respawning already counts as death.

We hope you’ll enjoy it and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!
