notes.title: Historical Skins – T-80BVM Greshnik
notes.content:
Commanders!

It’s been a while since we had a new historical skin, so let’s take a look at what we are bringing you in February. This year’s Defender of the Fatherland Day will feature an interesting skin called [b]Greshnik for T-80BVM[/b] along with other assets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7e97e6de9c0ee6e0bff5543486c556e598cfc4da.jpg[/img]

The skin is based on a specific T-80BVM (some sources claim it’s T-90M Proryv but it is not) belonging likely to the Russian Pacific Fleet Marines, as photographed around the summer of 2023. The vehicle seems to be a simplified “Model 2022” without the Sosna-U optics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/0458f6dc156d97b8dae6aaaafc4d5a8d35f918f3.jpg[/img]

The “Model 2022” is an unofficial name – the official one is much longer and not exactly convenient: "Tank T-80BVM (1A43-11, 1PN-96MT-01)".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f4ee2776ffa81cd628fe1dc60bab995483e0d46e.jpg[/img]

Aside from traditional Russian tricolor emblems and the flag of the Russian Navy, the vehicle bears a prominent name Greshnik (“Sinner”) on its upper frontal plate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d73967f62639483193be843f2db89a897dec1ac9.jpg[/img]

The tactical number 211 is complemented by a red triangle emblem, which typically appears on Russian Marine vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/9d89920d29c18fff8f2a692f1c24032de1fd48ef.jpg[/img]

Aside from the look, it’s worth noting that the skin will automatically unlock the following modules:

[list]
[*]     Top armor configuration
[*]     APS
[/list]

That way, you’ll be able to enjoy your T-80BVM in its maximum configuration without having to unlock the modules first. But that’s not all that we have for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c67d026f5821db95cc8b79f6f3c08ec1a1f98b14.jpg[/img]

There’s the Russian (Spetsnaz) camouflage as featured on vehicles used by elite operators and, of course, two separate decals:

[list]
[*]     Drone Elite
[*]     Air Defense
[/list]

Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3b4de6ef9dd849b0adaa86c25efa796c42887864.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a20adda1d68a3b90892ac80a26672ee94f0482ab.jpg[/img]

We hope that you’ll enjoy these new customization options and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: In Development: Typhoon-VDV
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today, we have a new vehicle for you that’s coming to Armored Warfare in February. You’ve been asking for powerful scouts to complement the Sphinx and Jaguar on high Tiers and boy do we have one for you. Enter the [b]Typhoon-VDV![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/39812b9c3659c3e8061b0f50786f4b3ca9f0172c.jpg[/img]

But first, a bit of history as usual.

The history of the Typhoon family of armored vehicles began with the requirement for a modern multi-purpose wheeled platform with unified components for the Russian military. The history of the project began with cooperation between several major companies, including UralAZ, KamAZ, YaMZ (engine), NII Stali research institute (armor) plus a few more.

The project was launched in 2010 although the attempts to design this kind of platform go back to the 1980s and the Soviet Union (before its collapse). The 1990s were not a good time for Russia and many projects (including this one) were cancelled due to budget cuts only to be re-started in the 2000s and 2010s when the economic situation improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2021ff6378f36b504b38439a4c78c3e093a179da.jpg[/img]

The program was primarily launched to replace the aging unprotected trucks and other means of infantry transport and the first prototypes that came from it in 2011 (Typhoon-U and Typhoon-K) were 6-wheelers. These are highly modular with many different configurations. The lighter version of the platform with 4 wheels came a few years later, in 2015, with the KamAZ-53949 Typhoon 4x4 (also unofficially referred to as “Little Typhoon”).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/40813e2bf40be54283567bcabf9b3d43b712cdb8.jpg[/img]

The KamAZ K-4386 Typhoon-VDV is a further development of the “Little Typhoon”. It is an air-droppable protected special-purpose vehicle (ZASN-D) for the Russian Airborne Forces. In its basic modification, the vehicle is equipped with the 32V01 Spitsa remotely controlled combat module with a 30mm 2A42 autocannon and a PKTM machine gun. It can also be equipped with a 9K111-1M Konkurs-M anti-tank missile system with two launch tubes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/84e593510020546ccc2d96235ee7313c607e4c68.jpg[/img]

The number of built Typhoon-VDV vehicles is unknown. The vehicle underwent the state trials in 2020 and allegedly entered official service. An export version is offered since 2021. It has seen combat since 2022 but the amount of vehicles built is unknown, likely quite low.

In Armored Warfare, the Typhoon-VDV will be a Tier 10 Premium AFV.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/05d695cb462737fb3bbfe41eb99653568c77c11e.jpg[/img]

Typhoon-VDV will be a classic scout, on which you can expect solid mobility and firepower but low armor. Its main task on the battlefield will be to spot enemy targets – but spotting alone wouldn’t make for a fun vehicle to play, which is why the Typhoon has some nasty teeth in the form of:

[list]
[*] 30mm autocannon comparable in damage output to the T-15
[*] Konkurs-M launcher with two tubes, capable of launching two missiles at once (thermobaric warheads are available)
[/list]

But that’s not all. In real life, Typhoon-VDV is meant for recon specialists and is packed with advanced equipment and electronics. As such, it serves as a hub for relaying information back to other troops. In Armored Warfare, this is reflected by a special new ability that increases the view range for all vehicles all around it by 30 meters, giving especially scout platoons an edge on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ae4a4123bd9f9acfd19e281d4865d58fe3ff417c.jpg[/img]

All in all, the vehicle will be ideal not only for pure spotting lovers, but also for players who want to use its firepower to take care of lighter enemies quickly and efficiently.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 0.250 Now Available
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the Update 0.250 is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/c1c2b629eb3fcf49419e1ec87317fb30a06c7b07.png[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.250 Changes[/h2]

[h3]TOS-1M Changes[/h3]

In this update, we are addressing the matter of TOS-1M and its gameplay. The vehicle currently has two issues. First, thanks to its armor and the lack of ammo rack it can ride out, deal enormous damage while weathering incoming fire, and hide again for reload. Secondly, the basic 122mm configuration is useless due to its abysmal accuracy. We are therefore introducing the following changes:

[list]
[*] Reduced the frontal turret armor of the vehicle (thus creating a large weakspot)
[*] Removed the “unmanned turret” feature
[*] Hard-kill APS now only works in the frontal arc (much like the one on the KF51 Panther)
[*] Increased the accuracy of 122mm rockets
[/list]

[h3]AFT-10 Improvements[/h3]

The AFT-10 Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer has been underperforming for a long time. We are therefore introducing the following changes:

[list]
[*] Vehicle’s ATGMs now ignore soft-kill APS
[*] Increased the missile agility from 20 deg/s to 30 deg/s
[*] Increased the camouflage factor from 20% to 30%
[*] Reduced the time between launches from 3.53s to 3s
[*] Reduced the launcher reload time from 34s to 30s
[/list]

[h3]Seahawks Battle Path[/h3]

In this update, we are correcting several issues of the Seahawks Battle Path and its vehicles:

[list]
[*] VN20: Fixed an issue where the vehicle received too high damage by ramming
[*] VN20: Fixed other smaller visual issues
[*] Fixed the description of the “Eliminate the Marauders!” mission

notes.title: Armored Warfare: 2024 in Review
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5f44161e076b125f75638869f30a78d785a82e77.jpg[/img]

[h3]Commanders![/h3]

As 2024 ends, it’s the perfect time to look back at the year’s highlights. From the impactful Shockwave Update to the story-driven Seahawks Battle Path and the tactical challenges of Lone Star, Armored Warfare has introduced exciting new content and challenges. With additions like the EMBT and XM2001 Crusader, this year brought a variety of memorable moments for commanders around the globe. Let’s take a closer look at what defined 2024 on the battlefield:

[h3]January: AS90[/h3]

We started the year with a bang—quite literally—with the release of the AS90, a Tier 8 Premium Self-Propelled Gun. Armed with high-damage HE and HEAT shells and exceptional mobility, the AS90 proved to be a devastating addition to any arsenal. Originally available for free through a Contract, it is now obtainable only through loot crates, direct purchase, or the Battle Path shop.

[previewyoutube=TobN00dKYAU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]March: Europe’s Edge Battle Path[/h3]

Spring saw the arrival of the Europe’s Edge Battle Path, celebrating modern European engineering with exclusive camouflages and reward vehicles, including the Leopard Cockerill (Tier 8 Premium LT), Ajax (Tier 10 Premium AFV), and KF51 Panther (Tier 10 Premium MBT). Initially obtainable as Battle Path rewards, these vehicles are now available only through loot crates, direct purchase, or the Battle Path shop.
Commanders also unlocked rare vehicles like the Object 787 Gadyuka and CV90120T Ghost, while revamped chain missions added a fresh twist to the campaign.

[previewyoutube=WnkzH-poeWo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]June: Tales from the Dark Battle Path[/h3]

Summer brought the Tales from the Dark Battle Path, a four-month campaign steeped in mystery. Players competed for powerful rewards, including the BTR-82A (Tier 8 Premium AFV), BMP-2M (Tier 9 Premium AFV), and T-90M (Tier 10 Premium MBT), all of which are now available through loot crates, direct purchase, or the Battle Path shop.

[previewyoutube=-f5ICvEr3k8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]August: EMBT[/h3]

The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) made its debut in August, showcasing advanced French and German engineering. Equipped with the 140mm ASCALON cannon, Trophy APS, and Galix soft-kill APS, this Tier 10 sniper MBT excels in long-range engagements and is a true technological marvel.

[h3]August: Lone Star Special Operation[/h3]

The second chapter of the Black Company saga, Lone Star, transported commanders to the urban battlegrounds of Port Houston. This mission challenged players to liberate a prisoner camp while navigating intense close-quarters combat. Rewards included the Lone Star camouflage, a Cowboy avatar, and 28 new achievements.

[previewyoutube=Ze7qrFWZuZE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]September: T-80BVM[/h3]

The T-80BVM, a progression Main Battle Tank, finally joined the catalog of vehicles available for research in Armored Warfare FOR FREE! Boasting upgrades from Russia’s Motobol program, it features Kontakt-5 ERA and a 1250hp turbine engine, delivering exceptional performance in cold environments. As a key link in the Soviet tank lineage, the T-80BVM stands out as a formidable addition to the progression lineup.

[previewyoutube=IVB-2q_84lw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]September: T-64BV Mod. 2017[/h3]

The T-64BV Mod. 2017, a Tier 7 Premium MBT, brought Ukrainian engineering to the forefront. Featuring Nizh ERA, a 125mm cannon with gun-launched missiles, and superior mobility, this assault tank is both agile and formidable in frontal engagements.
As a reward vehicle for the seasonal contract, it’s not too late to join the event! Complete daily and weekly missions to claim this powerful prize.

[h3]October: Shockwave Update[/h3]

The Shockwave Update introduced the thrilling Shockwave Mode, a survival endgame challenge for Tier 10 vehicles. Teams of five faced relentless waves of enemies in a fight for survival and high rewards.
In addition, the update delivered exciting improvements:

[list]
[*] Dynamic Decals for enhanced customization.
[*] New Sounds for iconic vehicles like the T-72 series.
[*] PELE Overhaul for improved shell mechanics.
[*] Crew and Commander Upgrades, including a new skill slot.
[*] Crew Upgrades: A new sixth training level was added, along with an extra skill slot for greater tactical flexibility.
[*] Commander Changes: Commanders saw adjustments to their abilities, offering more opportunities to refine strategies and improve battlefield performance.
[*] Friendly Fire Adjustments for smoother team gameplay.
[/list]
This update set a new benchmark for immersive combat.

[previewyoutube=6ztGOpNW9Ic;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]December: Seahawks Battle Path[/h3]

The Seahawks Battle Path brings Armored Warfare’s lore to life with its Diary feature, chronicling the history of the Seahawks unit. Commanders can earn epic rewards, including:

[list]
[*] Cheonma-2 (Tier 10 Premium MBT)
[*] VN20 (Tier 10 Premium TD)
[*] XK3 Phantom (Tier 10 Premium MBT)
[/list]
Additional rewards include upgraded commanders, exclusive skins, and vehicles like the Abrams AGDS and Stingray 2 Black Eagle. With revamped missions and story-driven gameplay, this Battle Path is already shaping up to be a year-end highlight.

The campaign is live now! Join the action today and start earning these incredible rewards!

[previewyoutube=0eIOgp52xNI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]December: XM2001 Crusader[/h3]

Closing out the year, the XM2001 Crusader delivered precision artillery strikes with its 155mm gun and three-round magazine. This Tier 10 Premium SPG combines exceptional speed (67 km/h) with moderate armor and requires careful positioning due to its turret’s limited traverse angle. The Crusader’s firepower and mobility make it a standout addition to any commander’s arsenal.

Starting December 26, the Crusader will be available through blueprint loot crates, giving commanders another opportunity to add this formidable vehicle to their collection.

[h3]Thank You, Commanders![/h3]

2024 has been an incredible journey, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Here’s to more adventures in 2025—see you on the battlefield!

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Cashback Event is here!
notes.content:
Commanders!

For this holiday season, we've prepared a very special event for you. [b]Receive a cashback[/b] from every purchase and spending of Gold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/18e97fb8210a14fb52e80560f30c248de7ce163c.png[/img]

Between [b]December 20 and December 31, 2024[/b], participate in this special event and get back some of your spendings in Gold that’ll be sent to your account when the event’s over. The more you spend, the more Gold you get back! In order to participate, you have to do one of the following:

[list]
[*] Make a purchase on [url=https://arwar.co/4fsiJy6]Web Shop[/url]
[*] Spend Gold in the game (for example in the active Battle Path)
[/list]

Your spending will be tracked and a part of the appropriate amount of Gold will be sent back to you after the end of the event. The more you spend, the more you get back – but please note that the maximum amount of Gold you can get back this way is limited.

Here, you can find everything that you need to know:

[list]
[*] Current amount spent and the limits
[*] Info about the cashback event and its limits
[/list]

Press the button below to track your progress:

[url=https://arwar.co/49QypKo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a75d622f9814c0fe50fffad57166c01100d858ee.png[/img][/url]

The full version of rules and regulations of the event can be found in the FAQ section. Participation is easy – log in, buy items in the Web Shop or spend Gold. The rest is handled by us.

[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2]

[b]How can I participate in the event?[/b]

In order to participate, all you need to do is one of the following things:

[list]
[*] Buy something in the [url=https://arwar.co/4fsiJy6]Web Shop[/url]
[*] Spend Gold in game
[/list]

[b]How much Gold do I get back?[/b]

The amount you get back is calculated based on your spending and is modified by appropriate coefficients. The more you spend, the more you get back – up to a certain limit.

[b]The coefficients are calculated as such:[/b]

[list]
[*] For every 1 EUR (or USD) spent, you get 66 Gold back
[*] For every 1 Gold spent, you get 0.25 Gold back (so 25 Gold back for 100 Gold spent and so on)
[*] At most you can spend 75 EUR or USD during the event (which would give you 4.950 Gold back)
[*] At most you can spend 9.000 Gold during the event (which would give you 2.250 Gold back)
[/list]

You can at most get 7.200 Gold back by combining both methods.

[b]What’s the maximum amount I can get back (the limit)?[/b]

The most you can get back is 7.200 Gold. You can track the progress on our web page.

[b]When will I get the Gold back?[/b]

Within several work days from the end of the event.

[b]Where can I see the status of my cashback?[/b]

[url=https://arwar.co/49QypKo]On a dedicated web page.[/url]

[b]How many purchases can I make?[/b]

During the event, you can buy as many bundles as you like and they will all count towards the cashback amount. Each purchase will be added to the progress bar.

[b]Why is the page not updating with new purchases?[/b]

The update happens in real time (or with a small delay) so please try refreshing the page.

[b]What if it doesn’t appear even after 24 hours from the purchase?[/b]

Contact our [url=https://arwar.co/4iJ76FL]support service.[/url]

[b]What can I do if I have further questions or want to report issues?[/b]

Contact our [url=https://arwar.co/4iJ76FL]support service.[/url]

[b]What kind of purchases do count towards cashback?[/b]

Web Shop purchases and Gold purchases via the Top Up button.

[b]What if I have multiple accounts?[/b]

Each account is dealt with separately. They cannot be combined for the purposes of this event.

[b]How will I know the cashback Gold was sent already?[/b]

Aside from a general in-game notification, the news about cashback being sent will be published on the game’s portal.

[b]What happens if I don’t reach the maximum limit?[/b]

Reaching the limit is not mandatory. You will get as much as is shown on the web page for your account.

[b]What can I use the cashback Gold on? Are there any limitations?[/b]

It’s your Gold – you can use however you see fit.

See you on the battlefield!

[b]Between December 19 and December 26[/b], 2024, the following items will be available:


[h2]KF51 Panther[/h2]

The KF51 Panther Main Battle Tank first appeared in 2022 as a demonstrator of Rheinmetall’s capabilities, mating a modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret armed not only with cutting edge weaponry, but also a missile launcher. The Panther is one of western next-gen MBT projects, much like the EMBT and the next-generation Abrams. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-kf51-panther]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ecbd75a958915ae7db53e8136fe23b4dd794d164.png[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the KF51 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. The KF51 Panther is at its core a medium-range vehicle with reliable armor and solid firepower that, in addition to its 130mm gun and NERA armor, boasts a powerful missile launcher. This combination makes it one of the most powerful MBTs you can encounter in the game.

[b]In the future, the vehicle will receive an optional module allowing the Panther to use the Hero-120 drones instead of missiles.[/b]

The KF51 Panther Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]EMBT[/h2]

The Enhanced Main Battle Tank (EMBT) is a future MBT demonstrator developed over the course of several years as cooperation between the Germany (KMW) and the French (Nexter). It features a heavily modified Leopard 2 hull with a brand-new turret unveiled in 2022 during the Eurosatory 2022 expo in Paris. Our version of the tank is armed with 140mm ASCALON gun. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-embt]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a2aae2dae1bc64164e13e6f69301ee335c60328e.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the EMBT is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Extreme accuracy and firepower are its domain as it features an incredibly powerful 140mm gun and a special ability called Machine Learning that increases the kinetic round penetration with each shot (up to three times). In its medium range support vehicle role, this tank has few equals thanks to the abovementioned ability and the availability of top-attack HEAT rounds.

The EMBT Tier 10 Premium MBT is available in our Web Shop via Loot Crates. Collect 100 blueprint pieces from these crates to obtain the vehicle.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Obsidian Blade Bundle (ZTZ-20)[/h2]

Skins rarely go more epic than this. The Obsidian Blade is a unique Main Battle Tank of unknown origin and David Murdoch's personal war chariot. As its name suggests, the tank’s surface us covered with a layer of obsidian. The cracks in the layer are filled with pure gold, as befitting a man of his influence. This skin also features unique visual effects such as the glowing coolant vapors coming out from underneath its armor. The skin is available for the ZTZ-20 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank (also currently on offer).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a9743f7736c6ab8115d39580de3bf1a1f7112570.jpg[/img]

[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Panzergrenadier Bundle[/h2]

In addition to the Puma Tier 10 Premium AFV, we have prepared a special skin for it. The skin is based on the camouflage used by Panzergrenadierbataillon 33 (33rd Mechanized Infantry Battalion) stationed in Neustadt am Rübenberge near Hannover (northern Germany, the state of Lower Saxony). You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-panzergrenadier]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d491c8020c3b78d66e7f44a2d2699dd13b3cf0ca.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Panzergrenadier Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Panzergrenadier
[*]     8 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Defender Bundle (T-80UM-1)[/h2]

This skin for the T-80UM-1 Tier 8 MBT is based on the camouflage and markings as seen in 2006 on a T-80U in Kubinka. You can read more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-t-80um-1-defender]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/84fc2eb5327ce4365f42ec7060634caf9a940c32.jpg[/img]

We are offering the Defender skin in a bundle, which includes:

[list]
[*]     Defender skin for the T-80UM-1 MBT
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]BMP-1P Spetsnaz Skin[/h2]

The skin for the BMP-1P Tier 4 AFV is based on a BMP-1 belonging to the 101st Special Operations Brigade of the Internal Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation, as seen during the Battle of Grozny in 1996. You can read more in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-bmp-1p-spetsnaz]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/b4814a423bb2b5854121af568d8ce8f992a26406.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Spetsnaz Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Spetsnaz
[*]     Russian (Interior Forces) camouflage
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Leopard 2 Revolution[/h2]

The Leopard 2 Revolution is a continuation of the older Evolution upgrade, intended to improve the performance of the older variants of the Leopard 2 Main Battle Tank in order to make it excel even on the battlefields of the 21st century. The improvements include a comprehensive armor upgrade, ROSY soft-kill APS and smoke grenade launchers as well as an entire suite of cutting edge electronics. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leopard-2-revolution]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3846c70a3a6e49eb41c26bf378989701ab5bd63d.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Leopard 2 Revolution is a Tier 8 Main Battle Tank. It is not only well-armored, it also features an extremely accurate 120mm gun with advanced ammunition, allowing it to destroy its opponents at very long ranges, rivaling those of Tank Destroyers. The German tanks in general perform best at longer ranges and the Revolution is no exception.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Leclerc T40[/h2]

Sometimes called the French Terminator, this vehicle was designed on the Leclerc MBT chassis with one purpose in mind – to accompany tanks and fight off infantry attacks the same way as the Russian BMPT series does. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-leclerc-t40]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4079a69d41017c550ae8cec52d6a60b0b791bb3c.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Leclerc T40 is a Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer. It offers you a combination of a durable hull, rapid-fire 40mm automatic cannon and, most importantly, the Javelin missile system. Simply right-click the target, wait until it becomes locket and fire the Javelin ATGM – it will home itself on the target, attacking its weak roof armor. Thanks to this ability, the Leclerc T40 is one of the most destructive vehicles in the game.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Marder 2[/h2]

The Marder 2 was an experimental German IFV, developed in the late 1980s to replace the aging Marder IFV. It featured more armor, a new turret and a brand-new Rheinmetall dual-caliber autocannon that could fire both 35mm and 50mm rounds. Despite its qualities, the vehicle was never accepted in service due to its high cost and because it was no longer needed because of the fall of the Soviet Union. A single surviving prototype can be found today in the Koblenz military collection. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-marder-2]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/cb9057ff357b4c6a2edc01c083aac6e4f444b158.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Marder 2 is a Tier 8 Armored Fighting Vehicle. With its 44 tons, it’s one of the heaviest and toughest AFVs around. Unlike many other AFVs of its Tier, it is not armed with guided missiles, relying instead on its extremely powerful 50mm autocannon. This vehicle can also deploy Mechanized Infantry.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Pile of Gold[/h2]

We also have the Pile of Gold Loot Crate for you. This Loot Crate contains copious amounts of Gold for you to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ee8c59781b575fe38ed2afabaf51c674ca72a20e.jpg[/img]

This Loot Crate includes:

[*]     50.000 Gold
[*]     10.000 Gold
[*]     5.000 Gold

[*]     500 Gold

[/list]

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Offer: Tier 10 Direct Sales
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you (directly available, no loot crates):

[list]
[*]     AbramsX Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Altay Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*]     Object 640 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[/list]
[b]Between December 16 to December 23, 2024[/b], the following items will be available:

[h2]AbramsX[/h2]

AbramsX is an advanced technology demonstrator. It was built as a private venture by General Dynamics Land Systems and unveiled in 2022 to show what the future of the Abrams MBT could look like. It is considerably lighter than a fully upgraded Abrams while retaining its protection levels and firepower thanks to its cutting edge systems. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-abramsx]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f884c23e3a0e7f26e2fde71118eefa1b7682ec1c.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the AbramsX is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. While still maintaining the basic Abrams line features such as a 120mm gun, it is considerably lighter and less armored. On the other hand it is also faster, more agile, stealthier, and features a 30mm autocannon that can reduce most light vehicles to a pile of scrap in seconds thanks to its new ammunition. As a result, this tank can dish out a lot of damage but requires careful and skilled gameplay.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Altay[/h2]

The Altay is the result of a Turkish program to build a true indigenous MBT. After a decade of development with hundreds of millions of dollars spent, Turkey finally achieved its goal and built a tank that is roughly on par in performance with decades-old Leopard 2 variants while it still uses many foreign components, including some of its most critical systems. Nevertheless, future Altay variants are expected to feature some cutting edge components.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/293b7fbb0a09b8c59458aeb6304c1c8164503a25.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Altay is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank based on the current prototypes, but also upgraded by various hypothetical aftermarket components of the future to surpass its current capabilities and to match its assigned Tier in power. The basic tank is – gameplay-wise – a mobile sniper, much like the Leopard 2 series, relying on its mobility and the penetration of its shells rather than on its armor. There are two key features to this tank: Adjustable Suspension (tilting forward and to the side) and Hybrid Engine with its distinctive electric sound, giving the vehicle excellent mobility and agility.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Object 640[/h2]

The Object 640 is one of the last Soviet era “super tank” monsters, designed to surpass anything the west could field on the battlefield. It featured extremely advanced armor, making it highly resistant to hits while keeping its weight low. The design was truly revolutionary for the late 1980s, but, like with many other Soviet projects of the era, it was discontinued due to the lack of funding. You can learn more about it in a [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-object-640-black-eagle]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/788a6065d1596d8ba056bc84794dc3eb7acf97e5.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Object 640 “Black Eagle” is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. It is a fast, agile and well-protected vehicle that plays in a typical Russian-style MBT fashion – ideal for players who want to take things up close and personal. This version of the tank does not feature any camouflage and is ready to be customized as you see fit.

This bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://arwar.co/3VedCdw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Coming soon: Cold as Ice
notes.content:
Commanders!

Is your heart cold as ice right about now from all that chilly weather? Allow us to warm it up with a special event featuring Seahawks Battle Coins and other great things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/57045ef56641157e19db6678175faebc8cd1f617.jpg[/img]

This event will start tomorrow morning and will be available until January 12, 2025. Its rules are, once again, very simple. You can participate simply by destroying 5 enemy vehicles in PvE (or 1 in PvP) every day (while driving a Tier 3 vehicle or higher) in order to receive a reward.

But what is the theme, you might ask? Well, dear players, it’s you. All those times you posted things like “wouldn’t it be nice if we had this flag or that decal” and thought we couldn’t possibly be listening? As it turns out, were in fact were – and here’s the evidence. Let’s take a look at some of the prizes:

[b]Cheese camouflage[/b] – all those times you likened Object 490 to a slice of cheese? Well, now you can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/548c81e10d5267aeff661479f97260333de2089d.jpg[/img]

[b]Ice Storm camouflage[/b] – this wasn’t requested by you per se, but it still is a very nice pattern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/100de3a88ca4b0c4e6129645d5462f4a23686ed6.jpg[/img]

[b]Flag of Yugoslavia[/b] – both a decal and a flag, as requested quite a few times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bb2f1f487ec9c19a9ab75539c68675e710d6a349.jpg[/img]

[b]Googly Eyes[/b] – this decal is just perfect for the Abrams, isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/276c3cece65562de0cbcf8f024bebddfd0985ece.jpg[/img]

[b]White Lancers[/b] – at long last, the emblem of this Polish PMC from Armored Warfare lore is making an appearance. That one is a real blast from the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/422b19f009fc91796d2a54ced03d2823d694f862.jpg[/img]

There’s more, of course, but we don’t want to spoil everything just now. Is there anything else you’d like to see in the game in the future? Let us know on Discord and we’ll take a look. But for the time being:

[b]Please note[/b]:

[list]
[*] This event may run concurrently with other events and is available to all players
[*] You may only complete one objective per day
[*] The event starts on December 12, 2024 and ends on January 12, 2025
[/list]

We hope that you will enjoy this event and will see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 0.247 Now Available
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.247[/b] is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4c8c80e61a3b228be4287d217f51cd1645f9f844.jpg[/img]

[h2]List of Update 0.247 Changes[/h2]

[b]Progress Boost for Vehicles[/b]

All progression vehicles now offer special bundles in exchange for Gold that will instantly boost that vehicle’s progress to maximum. If you have some progress accumulated on a vehicle, the bundle gets progressively cheaper. See the screenshot above for an example. In connection with this feature, each progression vehicle’s “progression” section was moved to the top of its Upgrades window.

Please note that the bundle incorrectly states it offers “Reputation” instead of the correct “Experience” – this will be fixed.

[b]Seahawks Battle Path[/b]

In this update, we are correcting several issues of the Seahawks Battle Path and its vehicles:

[list]
[*] Fixed the Grimm’s Leadership mission description (the mission requires 17 completions as per the counter while the description stated 15)
[*] Fixed the Seahawk mission icon in the debriefing window
[*] VN20: Sentry turret kills are now displayed correctly in the UI
[*] XK3 Phantom: The Ambush ability is now set as a default one
[/list]

[b]XM2001 Crusader[/b]

Please note that compared to the article, the vehicle gained two new abilities:

[list]
[*] M982 Excalibur guided HE shells
[*] Supercharged soft-kill APS

[b]Additional Vehicle Fixes and Updates[/b]

With each patch we continue (and will continue) to update vehicles based on your feedback and fix them. In this update, we have the following changes for you:

[list]
[*] Altay: Target lock for the top attack shells now has its correct sound
[*] Boxer RIWP: TOW turret no longer comes with partially loaded ATGMs

[*] BMP-2M: Fixed many other smaller visual issues

[*] BTR-82A: Double missile launch module is no longer getting randomly removed
[*] BTR-82A: Roadwheels no longer clip into the suspension
[*] BTR-82A: Turret parts such as the machinegun can no longer be fired through
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed the headlight visual effect
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed an issue where the wheels didn’t connect with the ground properly
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed several texture issues (rubber parts in the front, shading in the back)
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed the gunfire visual effect
[*] BTR-82A: Fixed many other smaller visual issues
[*] Challenger 2 ATDU: Fixed the Desert Rat and Honey Badger skin icons
[*] K2 Black Panther: Target lock for the top attack shells now has its correct sound
[*] KF41 Lynx Prototype: Fixed several texture issues

[*] KF51 Panther: Fixed the rear light appearance

[*] TTB: Fixed the gun module size so that it cannot be damaged when firing outside of the turret

[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]

notes.title: Future of the Shockwave Mode
notes.content:
Commanders!

The initial pre-Season of the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shockwave-update-now-available]Shockwave mode[/url] (Season 0) is now over and the mode is no longer available for the time being. Tens of thousands of you participated in Season 0 and the mode was amongst the most popular in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/748721a6bc7904e0a493ee9cc86f353059b2e541.png[/img]

But there’s no denying there has been a lot of criticism raised, as [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/seahawks-battle-path-prize-highlights]addressed in our latest article[/url]. 
Specifically:

[list]
[*]     The mode forces players into close combat inside the capture circle, soon resulting in incredibly difficult and hectic melee suitable for only a handful of vehicles (this is definitely something we’ll address)
[*]     Some AI opponents are clearly too toxic and not fun to fight, be it those dealing unavoidable damage (AbramsX, Boxer RIWP) or capable of destroying player vehicles with one shot (T-15 Lieutenants)
[*]     Performance issues do exist for many players, especially during later waves
[*]     The base layout is not ideal and makes defense more difficult than intended
[*]     The amount of some rewarded currencies is clearly a bit too high
[*]     Ammo does not refill outside of the base
[*]     Mode statistics (losses) count towards general player statistics and are spoiling them
[/list]

So, what happens now? The good news is, we’ve already begun our work on the next iteration of the mode that will bring major updates to it, including:

[list]
[*]     Different gameplay addressing the issues above
[*]     Making all classes be usable in this mode
[*]     New rewards
[*]     Ladder system to compare your results
[/list]

And much more.

However, that all will take some time and we expect the next iteration of the mode to be ready by spring 2025.

While you wait, we’ll have more amazing new features for you to enjoy, including the second part of the Shockwave update that’s bringing the long-awaited [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-drones-and-anti-drone-defense]Drones mechanic[/url]. We’ll tell you more about those in a bit.

For now, thank you for staying with us and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.246 Now Available
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Update 0.246[/b] is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5827b8ef16d2d741e3e629e016f787e923533237.png[/img]

Please note that the Shockwave Season 0 is over and the mode is no longer available. Stay tuned for more info about our further plans for the Shockwave mode!

[h2]List of Update 0.246 Changes[/h2]

[b]Autocannon HE shell overhaul[/b]

We are overhauling the High Explosive shells for autocannons (with notable exceptions such as AbramsX and Boxer RIWP) to do the following:

[list]
[*]     HE shells will only deal full damage to unarmored or very lightly targets

notes.title: In Development: Autocannon HE Overhaul
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’d like to tell you more about the overhaul of High Explosive shells for autocannons that’s coming in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fa32eff2c6c5ad080b2628799117f1e6d2651d3f.jpg[/img]

The fact that something like this was coming was unfortunately made clear by an incorrect version of these changes that appeared on the game server along with the Seahawks Battle Path in Update 0.240. Just to be clear, the fact that some HE shells can frontally damage Main Battle Tanks is not intended behavior – quite the opposite.

This is one of the features where the goal is very easy to explain but the execution is difficult. Long story short, we sought a purpose for autocannon HE shells for a long time since they have been either rather toxic or completely useless.

The role we envisaged for these shells is therefore as follows.

[list]
[*] HE shells will only deal full damage to unarmored or very lightly targets
[*] Armored targets will be dealt no damage (or very limited damage)
[*] The HE shells will deal a lot of damage to external modules such as tracks, guns and ERA/NERA elements
[/list]

In other words, these shells will have a specific purpose now and we are sure you’ll put them to good use, commanders. You’ll have the opportunity to try them out very soon and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Tier 10 Direct Sales
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today we’ve prepared the following items for you (directly available, no loot crates):

[list]
[*] Stridsvagn 2000 Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank
[*] TOS-1M Buratino Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer
[*] Koshmar skin for TOS-1M
[/list]

[b]Between November 25 and December 2[/b], 2024, the following items will be available:

[h2]Stridsvagn 2000[/h2]

The Stridsvagn 2000 was to be Sweden’s next Main Battle Tank, designed to combat Soviet super-tanks such as the Black Eagle. For its time, the project was nothing short of revolutionary with extremely thick frontal armor and a powerful 140mm gun that could take on literally anything in its day. However, the Soviet threat dissipated with the collapse of the Soviet Union, which pushed Sweden to seek a cheaper solution to its tank problem, namely the Leopard 2 MBT. You can learn more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-stridsvagn-2000]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e9bbc60684cadf46ed79cf2a1fde51018b1590b4.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Stridsvagn 2000 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank that represents the essence of practicality. Solid armor, decent mobility and excellent damage over time output make this tank one of the most versatile tools you can have in your arsenal, equally capable in PvP and PvE. Aside from its advanced NERA armor, the Strv 2000 features a coaxial 40mm autocannon. The key to success is switching between both weapon systems and maximizing your damage output while your NERA armor eliminated one enemy shell after another.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]TOS-1M Buratino[/h2]

The TOS-1M Buratino is a prototype version of the Russian TOS-1/TOS-1A heavy rocket launcher. It was designed in 1997 at Omsk as an improvement to the old TOS-1 whose roots go back all the way to the Afghan War. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-tos-1m-buratino]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3cd0ccae33e2b0c63fbda87de044c991948b7e92.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the TOS-1M Buratino is a Tier 10 Premium Tank Destroyer. As befits its massive rocket launcher installed on the top of a T-90A MBT chassis, its firepower is all but unparalleled and you are looking at perhaps the most destructive vehicle of Armored Warfare. It is available in two configurations – with fast-launching 122mm rockets and the iconic 220mm rockets that can be unlocked either by installing a skin (Koshmar), or by progressing through an active Battle Path.

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Koshmar Bundle[/h2]

Additionally, we've prepared a skin bundle with a new skin. The skin “Koshmar” we have prepared for you is for the TOS-1M Tier 10 Premium TD. Not only is it cool looking, it also [b]unlocks the overprogression modules for you, including the 220mm turret and the 220mm thermobaric rockets[/b]. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-tos-1m-koshmar]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fd35b445ef7bd20de354d0b2a9457e5c3fd5a7ab.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Koshmar Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*] Skin: TOS-1M Koshmar
[*] 3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*] 500 Gold
[/list]

[b]This bundle is available in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop?tags=bundle][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

We hope that you will enjoy the offer and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Seahawks Battle Path is now available!
notes.content:
Commanders!

We’re happy to announce that the [b]Seahawks Battle Path[/b] campaign has just begun.

[previewyoutube=0eIOgp52xNI;full][/previewyoutube]

This four-month-long and story-driven campaign is bringing back the Diary feature, telling a story of the Seahawks unit that precedes the current Black Company special operations. You can now experience the tale first-hand.

The reward vehicles this time come from Andrew Clayburn’s personal collection:

[list]
[*] [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-cheonma-2]Cheonma-2[/url] Tier 10 Premium MBT for reaching Level 20
[*] [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-vn20]VN20[/url] Tier 10 Premium TD for reaching Level 35
[*] [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xk3]XK3 Phantom[/url] Tier 10 Premium MBT for reaching Level 50
[/list]

Additionally, other valuable prizes can be obtained by progressing in the Battle Path:

[list]
[*] Abrams AGDS Tier 9 Premium TD (or its full price in Gold)
[*] T-72 Victory Tier 5 Premium MBT
[*] Sabre Tier 6 Premium AFV
[*] Stingray 2 Black Eagle Tier 7 Premium LT
[*] Three recently upgraded commanders (Joshua Seagrove, Kathryn Grey and Fyodor Sokolov)
[*] Epic skins, camouflages, decals, paints and many other things
[/list]

You can review the prizes in the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/seahawks-battle-path-prize-highlights]following article[/url].

[h2]What’s New[/h2]

This Battle Path is story-driven, which means the Diary feature is making a comeback. Follow the tale of the Seahawks, now available in fifty stunning entries with dedicated art, so even those who have read it before can find something new in there. And, of course, players unfamiliar with the history of the Seahawks, Kathryn Grey and Joshua Seagrove can now read it in full

The missions have once again been overhauled to match the theme of the Battle Path. There are the new Seahawk Loot crates to be won (containing, amongst other things, more high-Tier vehicles) and the final mission prize was changed to the Abrams AGDS Tier 9 Premium TD. The Battle Coin shop prices were lowered and unified across Tiers and item types.

You can read more in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]following article[/url].

[h2]Accessing the Battle Path[/h2]

In order to join the Battle Path campaign, please enter the game and click on the Seahawks icon on the upper bar. From there, you can simply purchase the Battle Path access:

[list]
[*] Standard pass (access only)
[*] Golden pass with access and 50.000 Battle Coins
[/list]

The access can also be purchased in our Web Shop:

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

[b]Enjoy the event and see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Battle Path Commander Changes
notes.content:
Commanders!

In the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]Seahawks Battle Path article[/url], we mentioned that the three commanders featured as prizes in the Seahawks Battle Path would be getting an update.

These commanders are:

[list]
[*]     Joshua Seagrove
[*]     Kathryn Grey
[*]     Fyodor Sokolov
[/list]

Without further ado, here’s what we’ve done.

[b]Joshua Seagrove[/b] is and always has been intended as a wheeled Tank Destroyer commander since his vehicle is canonically a Stryker by the name of Avenger (featured as a skin in the Battle Path prizes).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/70e442c858ce30ee1fcf6cfe255db05dd386b09d.jpg[/img]

His focus should be on firepower, module destruction and camouflage. Therefore:

[list]
[*]     Joshua Seagrove’s main skill is now static (available in full state right from the initial rank) and provides 7% reload speed buff at the expense of 25% hitpoints
[*]     Two Tier 3 skills providing 3.33% bonus to rate of fire after destroying a module) got improved to 5% and moved to the corners of the field
[*]     Two Tier 3 skills providing 6.89% camouflage penalty reduction for firing a gun got improved to 8% and moved to the corners of the field
[*]     The entire vicinity of the main skill is now filled with Eagle Eye skills (increasing the ability to see through foliage)
[*]     Two Marksman skills (improving accuracy) are also above and below the main skill
[/list]


[b]Kathryn Grey[/b] is supposed to be an effective Abrams commander given her canonical lore choice of driving an M1A3 Abrams (also featured as a skin in the Battle Path).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/00df7db4794c4ad60248687dfe40d8ab9fd33c03.jpg[/img]

Once again, her focus is on MBT firepower. Therefore:

[list]
[*]     Kathryn Grey’s main skill was upgraded and received a new name, Warfighter. It now scales with ranks and provides up to 8% reload time improvement as long as you drive an MBT
[*]     The not-so-useful Track and Destroy skills in lower right corner were replaced by two fields of skills providing 15% chance to deal maximum damage (30% in total)
[*]     We have removed various condition skills triggering whenever an enemy is within 50m and replaced them with hull traverse skills without this condition
[*]     In the center of the field (that was previously empty) there is a new skill providing reload time improvement as long as there are no enemies present within 50m (regardless of class)
[/list]


And, finally, [b]Fyodor Sokolov[/b] is getting a set of smaller changes. His essence remains the same – he will provide an XP bonus, making him highly suitable as a commander for new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8711810282d204b6831ea84b02d7085cc02f3c1f.jpg[/img]

However:

    The top rank XP bonus is increased from 40% to 50%
    Replaced the Texas Duel skill (increasing accuracy) on the left side with another third rank repair skill
    On the left middle side, the ATGM and accuracy skills were replaced by Motivation skills (increasing crew statistics)

Please note that Maximilian König (previously a “clone” of this commander skill-wise) is not getting this overhaul and from now on will be different. As for Samuel Thorpe (who’s not connected to the Battle Path), he will receive a deeper overhaul that will be described in a separate article.

We hope that you will enjoy these changes and, as always:

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Developer Diary: U.S. Vehicle Changes
notes.content:
Commanders!

The [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]Seahawks Battle Path[/b][/url] is right around the corner and along with it come the American vehicle buffs we have announced in the article. So let’s take a look at them together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5827b8ef16d2d741e3e629e016f787e923533237.png[/img]

American vehicles have long been the “baseline” of Armored Warfare in the sense they aren’t really good or bad in any particular aspects. They are just “there” and with the introduction of more and more specialized vehicles, they got pushed into the background a bit. Well, no more, because in the next update, they are becoming awesome.

Let’s start with the [b]M1128 Stryker[/b], Joshua Seagrove’s favorite Tank Destroyer. It’s becoming a really mean vehicle on the battlefield with the following changes:

[list]
[*]     For the autoloader configuration we are changing the reload time within magazine from 3.54s to 2s
[*]     Added new HEAT-MP round with 855mm penetration and 610 damage
[*]     Added new APFSDS round with 760mm penetration and 470 damage
[*]     Significantly increased the vehicle’s agility
[/list]

Next is the [b]Bradley Fighting Vehicle[/b], the workhorse of the Seahawks. This vehicle’s performance has so far been mediocre, which is why we have made the following changes:

[list]
[*]     Added the 600hp VTA-903T engine (this significantly increases its mobility)
[*]     30mm and 40mm variants of the same gun are now separate modules with the 40mm gun having a new HE round
[*]     Added a new tandem HEAT warhead ATGM (with the same penetration and damage as the previous one but improved flight characteristics)
[*]     Added a new thermobaric warhead ATGM
[/list]

In other words, the Bradley’s becoming faster and hard-hitting. But the main part of the changes concerns the [b]Abrams MBT series[/b].

For starters, most of the Abrams tanks are getting a frontal armor overhaul. It’s an overall buff to the frontal armor, but some parts are actually becoming thinner. Simply put, the Abrams frontal armor’s about to behave differently and it’s up to you to learn how to deal with the nasty beasts that are the new Abrams tanks. It’s certainly possible, just not a matter of a single button push.

Next, let’s discuss the specific vehicles, starting with the [b]Tier 10 XM1A3[/b], which hasn’t been performing great as of late. On the contrary, it needed a serious buff, which is why we made the following changes:

[list]
[*]     ARAT-2 ERA is now working correctly against tandem warheads (this was more a bug fix than a buff and is a mechanical change rather than a value increase, feel free to test it in game)
[*]     Added a new Trophy Next Gen APS module with Supercharged APS ability
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration for both engines
[*]     120mm gun now has a new M1147 AMP remote detonation HE round
[*]     120mm M829E4 APFSDS damage increased from 600 to 650
[*]     140mm gun reload time improved from 9.8s to 9s
[*]     140mm gun accuracy of APFSDS and HEAT shells increased
[/list]

With the frontal armor buff, the XM1A3’s bound to become one of the best MBTs in Armored Warfare, period.

Next, the [b]Tier 9 M1A2C (and its Hades variant).[/b] Aside from the frontal armor buff, we are making the following adjustments:

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where the properties of ARAT-2 ERA didn’t change properly with this module installed
[*]     ARAT-2 ERA is now working correctly against tandem warheads (same fix as for XM1A3)
[*]     Added a new M1147 AMP remote detonation HE round
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration for both engines
[*]     Reload speed improved from 6.7s to 6s
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

For the [b]Tier 8 M1A2[/b], aside from the frontal armor buff as usual, we are making the following changes:

[list]
[*]     Added a new M908 HE round (840 damage, 50mm penetration)
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Reload speed improved from 6.7s to 6s
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

Following is the [b]Tier 8 Premium M1A1 AIM[/b], previously one of the most mediocre tanks of Armored Warfare. We checked its statistics and decided it finally deserves a proper buff. Therefore, aside from the frontal armor improvement, we have made the following changes:

[list]
[*]     APFSDS round changed from M829A1 to M829A2 (740mm penetration, 540 damage)
[*]     Added new XM943 STAFF top-attack HEAT round
[*]     Added new M908 HE round (840 damage, 50mm penetration)
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

The [b]Tier 7 M1A1[/b] can’t be left out either. You know the drill by now – frontal armor upgrade. But also:

[list]
[*]     Added new M908 HE round (840 damage, 50mm penetration
[*]     Reload speed improved from 6.7s to 6s
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 33 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

We’re coming to an end now. What’s left is the [b]Tier 6 M1[/b] with the frontal armor adjustment but also:

[list]
[*]     Added a new armor module that improves the frontal turret and hull armor even further
[*]     Added a new APFSDS round (690mm penetration, 430 damage)
[*]     Increased the initial acceleration of the engine
[*]     Reload speed improved from 5.8s to 5.4s
[*]     Significantly increased hull traverse from 25 deg/s to 41 deg/s
[/list]

The rest of the Abrams tanks (XM1, M1A1 Storm) performed well enough in order not to warrant major buffs but we didn’t forget them either:

[list]
[*]     XM1 (and XM1 Fox): APFSDS round changed to M833 (690mm penetration, 430 damage)
[*]     M1A1 Storm: Increased the initial acceleration of the engine (this will help nicely with your ramming maneuvers)
[*]     M1A1 Storm: Significantly increased hull traverse from 32.9 deg/s to 44 deg/s
[/list]

And that’s about it, commanders. The Abrams tanks should retain their jack-of-all-trades characteristics but at a significantly higher level now. We hope that you’ll enjoy devastating your opponents with them and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Seahawks Battle Path: Prize Highlights
notes.content:
Commanders!

The [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/battle-path-info-and-preorder]Seahawks Battle Path.[/url] is coming in November and we’d like to take a moment to tell you more about its prizes.

[previewyoutube=7-5myo_dsyc;full][/previewyoutube]

As you know already, the Battle Path will retell the story of the Seahawks, their odyssey across half of the planet and their fate – in other words, what happened before the Rate of Decay and Lone Star Special Operation. The story will be told via fifty diary entries (one per Battle Path level as usual) and the prizes of each level will be tied to their respective entries as in the previous story-driven Battle Paths.

The main prizes are, of course, the vehicles. There are three:

[list]
[*]     [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-cheonma-2]Cheonma-2[/url] Tier 10 Premium MBT
[*]     [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-vn20]VN20[/url] Tier 10 Premium AFV
[*]     [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-xk3]XK3 Phantom[/url] Phantom Tier 10 Premium MBT
[/list]

You can see them on the images below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bfb83a3d9b0953f65d4dc5dcb9c4f5e6083a826d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/4fb1a8a28a4b4ea86bd0cd525c0652286ce070f5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/89bccf8596f2dd71c511cd3350d53878a9f259b2.jpg[/img]

The VN20 will have, as announced earlier, a unique ability to deploy a turret targeting nearby enemies:

[previewyoutube=dXzpEBFfhQc;full][/previewyoutube]

But that’s not all. You’ll have the opportunity to also win the following items:

[list]
[*]     Abrams AGDS Tier 9 Premium TD (or its full price in Gold)
[*]     T-72 Victory Tier 5 Premium MBT
[*]     Sabre Tier 6 Premium AFV
[*]     Stingray 2 Black Eagle Tier 7 Premium LT
[*]     Three recently upgraded commanders (Joshua Seagrove, Kathryn Grey and Fyodor Sokolov – we’ll tell you more about later
[*]     Rest of Black Eagle skins (including the one for Object 640)
[/list]

But what you’re here for are the new skins and camouflages, right? Let’s take a look at them.

The most interesting is the [b]M1A3 Aces[/b] skin for the XM1A3 (which is getting a major buff and will be quite a powerhouse).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e0851ad2caa5a0de0960901ea3fb3a697cecfe39.jpg[/img]

In the world of Armored Warfare, the M1A3 is the ultimate version of the Abrams. Four vehicles from the initial production run were all undergoing trials in the desert when the order to return to the USA came and they were left behind along with most of the other equipment used by the U.S. forces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/94d9c3d912868ce7642c85e2fa02c9f5617bb436.jpg[/img]

The prototypes were soon after seized by scavengers and sold to the highest bidder within days due to the concern that Uncle Sam might be coming for his lost toys. The highest bidder turned out to be none other than Clayburn Industries with Andrew Clayburn allegedly taking personal interest in acquiring these feasome machines. One of these Abrams tanks, “Aces”, became the personal vehicle of Kathryn Grey who used it to great effect in Clayburn Industries service.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/35bbca5893686a7917ec6bdcd4696ce8da3780a0.jpg[/img]

The skin covers the XM1A3 with a camouflage kit similar to that of another skin, War Pig, although the XM1A3 one is somewhat different. It unlocks the hard-kill APS as well as the upgraded ERA kit on the vehicle and it can change colors as well based on the base paint you use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d26ea75b4fda02762c0a94aadbfba6dccd403b7c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/29e6040380a6ba3e50de6d0a8bf85aaa428dc69a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d47dea9598f35d38665af2b0cd03aef7cc8d7d30.jpg[/img]

The [b]Avenger skin[/b] for M1128 Stryker is based on Joshua Seagrove’s personal Stryker.

Like the Aces skin, the Avenger too unlocks the top armor configuration (in this case the ERA one) and allows you to change its color based on the selected base paint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2ab9c22bc9ce5f905062b432c6e4bd051b4d2506.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/7ac7c9d1a004c88d5bf0ca58a9d72919a0518095.jpg[/img]

The [b]Deathstalker skin[/b] is based on a real-life Sheridan that was used during Operation Desert Storm (3rd Battalion, 73rd Armor Regiment). After its decommissioning, it was sold off to a private collector by the name of Jacques Littlefield, whose collection became one of the most famous in the world and perhaps the largest in the USA.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e4e4e8ff449d7917acdb221b2e7f338d52606741.jpg[/img]

Mr. Littlefield unfortunately passed away in 2009 and his collection was partially auctioned off in 2014 to finance the creation of a new museum that would house the rest. And that’s where the real-life Deathstalker resides today – the American Heritage Museum in Hudson, Massachusetts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/1c2adfd17285c7e208f303c81296616ef901490c.jpg[/img]

And, last but not least, there’s the [b]Sentinel skin[/b] for AMX-30 BRENUS. Its appearance is based on a real-life French “opposing force” (FORAD) vehicle. After their retirement, the obsolete AMX-30 tanks served simulated enemy vehicles at CENZUB, a special French military facility near Sissonne for training urban combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3f73bea903ac41a332bb7e6fea9ef8c092c347f9.jpg[/img]

The unique camouflage it’s covered in is specific to this service and consists of three shades of grey and black rectangles. It likely first appeared around 2010. The vehicle bears the name “Sentinel” and, in the world of Armored Warfare, it was sold off and used by mercenaries in Africa.

We naturally have other prizes for you that are all tied to the story, such as the [b]epic camouflages[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a8b5b1b1be551d093b54cdd1c3fa029003fa45af.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a77bbf23fd1ef1602a4853b5d9d4e58080ef11de.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/8c88b6cdd3b512d2d712a664d07510b2d8f26699.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ede3a2c4f58a8adb3eb6d058c56630cf11e86b2b.jpg[/img]

Some new camouflages can [b]change their color[/b] based on the base paint:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/38d36ac232f7173427829f684423296d6bf3d6f3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/74fb437d69d4dadd36b6f1df85d7024ca746c1f8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/5a056336b8e5b0d246a95d849665cf7f0b1eadb6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/ef0bad4cc3127f6eca125072b74368541130ddac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/921dff918aa947c6ceb9566f049ad96f3286b45c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/f0534e3fbfd50a924377c200efab32075c15b14b.jpg[/img]

And, of course, there will be plenty of avatars, flags and decals waiting for you as well:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/351c8dedb0aa141b203f49ebdbf86f22efafb289.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/853bc8b599308d9c8a06e5c00831a1196c3ac5da.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/26eda75f202714ab4da3329f25827997ffbad83f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/bf91373bff360f9846da6179daa357c3e0e0fade.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/43de37374fc40783049594ae9ce64f1e2600d027.jpg[/img]

These are just examples and there will be many more prizes in this Battle Path. We hope that you’ll enjoy this event that is coming soon and, as always:

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Celebrating Polish Independence
notes.content:
Commanders!

On November 11, [b]Poland celebrates its anniversary as an independent nation[/b], forged in blood and fires of the Great War as well as the 1920 victory over Soviet invaders. Poland has always had an interesting and proud military history, never truly giving up during the Second World War and proudly continuing the fight from abroad. Regardless of the circumstances, Polish soldiers have always served with honor and dignity. Today, the Polish Army may very well be the most powerful single army in Europe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/e09686d2156f38b8debb88c16b633d228b2ab110.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bonus and Gift[/h2]

First and foremost, the 50% XP and 25% Credit income bonus is now available until November 14, 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/732c1e6dead871a14e5137ecfefacbaca536107b.jpg[/img]

Additionally, a gift is available in the Web Shop, containing the following items:

[list]

[/list]

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]

Furthermore, we have the following special offers for you:

[list]
[*]     Wilk Bunde
[*]     Asgard Bundle
[*]     Panzer 87-140 directly available
[*]     Battle Path Boosters
[/list]

[h2]Wilk Bundle[/h2]

The “Half-restored” skin is based on a story from the Warsaw military museum. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/sort-historical-skin-camouflage-and-decals-poland]dedicated article.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/fb6504df3eb024557c94c460b949de135211c92f.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Wilk Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: Half-Restored for T-72M2
[*]     T-72M2 Wilk Tier 6 Premium MBT
[*]     Polish camouflage (Classic Winter)
[/list]

The bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Asgard Bundle[/h2]

The skin “M1A2 SEP v2 Asgard” we have prepared for you is for the M1A2 Tier 8 MBT. It is based on a vehicle seen during the MSPO 2023 expo at Kielce. You can read more about it in our [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/historical-skins-m1a2-sep-v2-asgard]dedicated article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/3459826374e3a509b1d52e0f5b60067a961752ef.jpg[/img]

The skin is available as a part of the Asgard Bundle, which contains the following items:

[list]
[*]     Skin: M1A2 SEP v2 Asgard
[*]     3 Platinum Loot Crates
[*]     500 Gold
[/list]

The bundle is available in our Web Shop.

[url=https://armoredwarfare.com/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Panzer 87-140[/h2]

The Panzer 87-140 is an experimental version of Panzer 87 (Swiss Leopard 2A4), fitted with a RUAG 140mm smoothbore cannon and an armor kit called WE. It was developed in the 1980s and early 1990s to counter the next generation of Soviet MBTs, but with the collapse of the Soviet Union, the project was shelved, only to resurface around 2005-2006 but never passing the experimental stage. You can read more about it in our [b][url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-panzer-87-140] dedicated article.[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/a6ced3b38227fc4489038c44220d90f331c039dd.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Panzer 87-140 is a Tier 10 Premium Main Battle Tank. Much like other Leopard series MBTs, it’s a long-range fighter with an extremely powerful gun and the ability to fire with pinpoint accuracy. Even though its armor leaves much to be desired, at long range, this MBT has few equals and can be considered one of the best snipers of its class.

[b]This vehicle is now available directly in our Web Shop.[/b]

[url=https://aw.my.games/web-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/d54d0fd5cf329fefce23fe1f1928ef139e6a7e54.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Tales from the Dark Boosters[/h2]

This week, we are offering you an opportunity to [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/tales-dark-battle-path-now-available]boost your Battle Path[/url] progress and get that main prize you know you want – the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/development-t-90m-proryv]T-90M Proryv Tier 10 Premium MBT![/url]

We hope that you will enjoy this offer and, as usual:

notes.title: Shockwave: CEO’s Letter to the Community
notes.content:
Commanders!

Several days ago, we released the [url=https://armoredwarfare.com/en/news/general/shockwave-update-now-available]single largest update to Armored Warfare in years, “Shockwave.”[/url]

Following the transfer from MY.GAMES to our platform, this was another major milestone for us when it comes to addressing the future of Armored Warfare and putting the development on the right track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31078546/2c57f2a0094421cd1a7325270a84892941fd0f8a.jpg[/img]

However, with that being said, we are aware of your feedback regarding the update and especially the Shockwave game mode. Rest assured that we are committed to listening to it and are already processing it in order to improve the experience in the future. Most notably:
[list]
[*] 
[*] The mode forces players into close combat inside the capture circle, soon resulting in incredibly difficult and hectic melee suitable for only a handful of vehicles (this is definitely something we’ll address)
[*] Some AI opponents are clearly too toxic and not fun to fight, be it those dealing unavoidable damage (AbramsX, Boxer RIWP) or capable of destroying player vehicles with one shot (T-15 Lieutenants)
[*] Performance issues do exist for many players, especially during later waves
[*] The base layout is not ideal and makes defense more difficult than intended
[*] The amount of some rewarded currencies is clearly a bit too high
[*] Ammo does not refill outside of the base
[*] Mode statistics (losses) count towards general player statistics and are spoiling them
[*] We’ll definitely address all of these, some very soon and some a bit later. Additionally, we’ll launch a survey regarding the mode to get as much feedback as possible.
[/list]

But feedback is one thing; another is the scope of our plans for the mode’s proper Season 1 release next year. What we are planning to do is:

[list]
[*] Improve the gameplay to offer more viable vehicle and tactic choices
[*] Comprehensively overhaul the prize system so that you can earn not just Credits and XP during the mode but also additional visual cosmetics and more
[*] Integrate the mode into future Battle Path so that it can be used to complete various tasks and objectives
[*] Add a seasonal ladder tab so that the best teams can compare their results and the best-performing ones are able to earn legendary prizes
[/list]

In short this is only the beginning of the road for Armored Warfare’s future development and we’re incredibly excited to show you what else we have in store for the rest of the year, 2025, and beyond.

[b]Alexey Larionov, CEO, Wishlist Games[/b]
