notes.title: Offer: Bastille Day
notes.content:
Commanders!

On July 14, France celebrates the Bastille Day and we’ve prepared a special offer to celebrate the occasion, consisting of:
[list][*]Leclerc Prototype Bastille skin (along with other previously introduced French-themed skins)[/*][*]Two French camouflages[/*][*]OF-40 Barracuda skin[/*][*]ERC-90 F4 République Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][/list]
The following bundles are available [b]between July 11 and July 18, 2019:[/b]

 
[h1]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/h1]
 

The Bastille is a new French-themed skin for the Leclerc Prototype Tier 7 progression Main Battle Tank, celebrating the abovementioned holiday with the traditional French colors.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_5.jpg[/img]

Please note that this bundle does not contain the Leclerc Prototype Tier 7 MBT, only the skin itself. You have to own the Leclerc Prototype to use it. The skin alone is available in our [url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][b]Web Shop[/b][/url] for Gold as well as on [url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][b]MyLoot[/b][/url], but we’ve also prepared several MyLoot-exclusive bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 25% discount, containing:
[list][*]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/*][*]10 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]Bastille Day decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 35% discount, containing:
[list][*]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/*][*]10 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]Bastille Day decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][*]Bastille Day avatar (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
[b]French Bundle[/b] with 30% discount, containing:
[list][*]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/*][*]Barracuda skin for OF-40[/*][*]Vive la France skin for AMX 10 RCR[/*][*]Two French camouflages[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

 
[h1]Barracuda skin for OF-40[/h1]
 

The Barracuda is a special skin for the OF-40 Tier 4 progression Main Battle Tank. It features a massive camouflage net, inspired by the design of a real life system called Saab Barracuda. It won’t make your tank stealthier than any other camouflage, but it will definitely make it turn some heads.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_of-40_barracuda.jpg[/img]

Please note that this bundle does not contain the OF-40 Tier 4 MBT, only the skin itself. You have to own the OF-40 to use it. The skin alone is available in our [url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][b]Web Shop[/b][/url] for Gold as well as on [url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][b]MyLoot[/b][/url], but we’ve also prepared several MyLoot-exclusive bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 25% discount, containing:
[list][*]Barracuda skin for OF-40[/*][*]10 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]Bastille Day decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 35% discount, containing:
[list][*]Barracuda skin for OF-40[/*][*]10 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]Bastille Day decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][*]Bastille Day avatar (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
[b]French Bundle[/b] with 30% discount, containing:
[list][*]Bastille skin for Leclerc Prototype[/*][*]Barracuda skin for OF-40[/*][*]Vive la France skin for AMX 10 RCR[/*][*]Two French camouflages[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

 
[h1]French Camouflages[/h1]
 

We’ve also prepared two French historical camouflages. In reality, it’s pretty much one iconic camouflage with two different layouts that is most famous for its appearance on the Leclerc MBT. It consists of green, brown and black stripes and is available in two variants – one has the edges clearly defined while the other variant has them blurred. Both were observed on the Leclerc MBT, sometimes even on vehicles from the same series.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_camo_both.jpg[/img]

These camouflages are available:
[list][*]In our [url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][b]Web Shop[/b][/url] for Gold[/*][*]On [url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][b]MyLoot[/b][/url] for standard currency[/*][/list]
Please note that each of these camouflages can be installed on any vehicle that has the camouflage customization feature available (any vehicle with the exception of vehicles with permanent skins) and that each of these camouflages can be used in all three environments.

 
[url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

 
[h1]ERC-90 F4 République[/h1]
 

The ERC 90 (also known as “Sagaie”) is a French heavily armed reconnaissance vehicle and tank destroyer, named after a type of African spear. It was developed by Panhard from 1975 specifically for export, although France did purchase 192 in the 1980s. You can learn more about its history in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-erc-90-sagaie][b]dedicated article![/b][/url]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_erc-90.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the ERC 90 is a Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer. It’s one of the most popular vehicles amongst Tier 5 tournament players – and for a good reason! It combines a powerful 90mm cannon with excellent mobility, making it a truly deadly opponent. It’s fast and agile and when operated by an experienced player, the enemies don’t have a clue what hit them. The République version of the ERC-90 F4 also comes with unique French-themed camouflage!

Aside from being available alone with a discount, the following bundles are also available on MyLoot:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 35% discount, containing:
[list][*]ERC-90 F4 République Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][*]10 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]Bastille Day decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 50% discount, containing:
[list][*]ERC-90 F4 République Tier 5 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][*]10 Platinum Loot Crates[/*][*]10 Platinum Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]Bastille Day decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][*]Bastille Day avatar (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
 
[url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

[b]Please note:[/b]
[list][*]This offer starts on July 11 at 16:00 CEST (7 AM PDT, 17:00 MSK)[/*][*]This offer ends on July 18 at 16:00 CEST (7 AM PDT, 17:00 MSK)[/*][*]If you already owned a bundle vehicle, you will instead receive its Compensation Value in Gold instead[/*][/list]
[b]Enjoy the offer and see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: The French are here!
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to introduce the second and [b]final part of Francine De Laroche’s vehicle branch[/b], bringing you the long-awaited Char Leclerc and several other vehicles.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_4.jpg[/img]

The following vehicles are now available:

Please note, however, that it will not be possible to unlock the Tier 9 Leclerc from the Ariete. As for the exchange itself, the following rules apply:
[list][*]Ariete now counts as a Francine De Laroche vehicle (for the purpose of achievements)[/*][*]If you had the Ariete purchased in your Garage, you will automatically receive Al-Hussein[/*][*]If your Ariete has accumulated at least one point of Experience, the Al Hussein will be awarded to you fully unlocked[/*][*]If the Tier 9 token unlocked on the Ariete was used already, it will not be possible to unlock on the Al-Hussein MBT[/*][/list]

[list][*]Commander Vincent Girard can be unlocked from the Tier 10 Leclerc ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/introducing-commander-vincent-girard][b]learn more about him[/b][/url])[/*][*]New Pressure Control retrofit will be available for unlocking from the VCAC Mephisto ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-new-retrofits][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][*]Level 3 retrofit is now available for unlocking from the Leclerc[/*][*]The Mastery system is now available for the Leclerc T4[/*][*]New visual customization options[/*][/list]
The Level 3 (v3) retrofit Improved Barrel Lining is obtainable from the Tier 9 Leclerc MBT. It grants the following bonuses:
[list][*]13 percent bonus to Rate of Fire (same as Improved Gun Breach v2)[/*][*]5 percent reduction to Maximum Spread (same as Advanced MRS v1)[/*][/list]
In order to obtain it, one of the following feats must be performed 10 times:
[list][*]PvP (Random Battles): Be the one in your team to receive the most hits (no fewer than 10) while having Vincent Girard command your vehicle. You also need to resist at least 1.000 damage and damage no fewer than 7 vehicles in one match[/*][*]Global Operations: Be the one in your team to receive the most hits (no fewer than 10) while having Vincent Girard command your vehicle. You also need to win, resist at least 5.000 damage and damage no fewer than 12 vehicles in one match[/*][/list]
The Mastery system, currently only available for the Tier 10 Leclerc T4 MBT, will test your skill with that vehicle. It requires a completion of the following achievements 4 times:
[list][*]Obtain a Steel Eagle epic medal by helping destroy the largest amount of enemy vehicles on your team in Random Battles (at least 12 vehicles)[/*][*]Complete the Steel Avalanche mission by winning a PvP Random Battle match without taking any losses or a Global Operations match without losing more than 300 team points[/*][/list]
And last but not least, there are the new visual customization options:

[b]Leclerc Prototype – Rock snow camouflage:[/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190704_1330.jpg[/img]

[b]VCAC Mephisto – Stingray desert camouflage:[/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190704_1331.jpg[/img]

[b]Leclerc – Rock woodland camouflage:[/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190704_1332.jpg[/img]

[b]Leclerc T4 – Stingray snow camouflage:[/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190704_1333.jpg[/img]

We hope you will enjoy this new branch and will see you on the battlefield!

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Maintenance - July 11
notes.content:
On the [b]11th of July 2019[/b], starting from [b]8:00 CEST[/b] (10th of July, 11 PM PDT), the server will not be available for 4 hours due to the application of [b]Update 0.29.5602.[/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0325_0.jpg[/img]

[h1]List of Update 0.29.5602 Changes[/h1]

[b]New Francine De Laroche Vehicles[/b]

We are introducing the second part of Francine De Laroche’s vehicle branch Armored Warfare, consisting of the following vehicles:
[list][*]Leclerc Prototype Tier 7 MBT[/*][*]VCAC Mephisto Tier 8 TD[/*][*]Al-Hussein Tier 8 MBT (replacing the Ariete in the Challenger branch)[/*][*]Leclerc Tier 9 MBT[/*][*]Leclerc T40 Tier 9 Premium TD[/*][*]Leclerc T4 Tier 10 MBT[/*][/list]
These vehicles come along with additional features such as new camouflages and Commander Vincent Girard. More information will be released in a dedicated article.

[b]New Special Operation[/b]

The third Moscow Calling Special Operation that we promised earlier is now available, continuing the story of the disastrous Moscow summit and the events that followed. It’s bringing three new achievements:
[list][*]Moscow Resident 3[/*][*]Quick Robbery[/*][*]Not a Problem[/*][/list]
[b]ZUBR PSP – Additional Features[/b]

We are introducing additional progression elements to the ZUBR PSP Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer, obtainable for completing the Moscow Contract – specifically, three different upgrades. In order to obtain them, a certain number of Contract Missions have to be completed:
[list][*]ATGM Control Unit or Advanced Fire Control, boosting gun and ATGM accuracy, obtainable for completing 50 daily Contract Missions (or 10 weekly ones)[/*][*]Flash Suppressing Kit, boosting Camouflage and reducing Camouflage penalties, obtainable for completing 150 daily Contract Missions (or 10 weekly ones)[/*][*]Improved Loading Mechanism, boosting reload speed, obtainable for completing 300 daily Contract Missions (or 30 weekly ones)[/*][/list]
[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]For the sake of logical difficulty progression, we renamed the Special Operations difficulty levels from Challenging and Hardcore (Tier 9-10) to Hardcore and Extreme (since the lower Special Operations difficulty is on par with the higher standard PvE mission one)[/*][*]Fixed the issue where V-sync setting would not save correctly[/*][*]Fixed the issue that made the Head Start Contract Mission impossible to complete[/*][*]Fixed the issue where obtaining Battle Path skins would sometimes (rarely) lead to the loss of progress on the vehicles that can use them[/*][*]Fixed the issue where Crew Experience progress would sometimes (rarely) reset to the lower Crew level[/*][*]AFT-10: fixed the incorrect ATGM nerf – missiles now accelerate faster and the camouflage penalty for firing was reduced from 0.2 to 0.05 per shot[/*][*]BMPT series: ATGMs now fly from correct spots[/*][*]BWP-2000: fixed the aiming issue and reduced the efficiency of this vehicle’s HE shells by reducing their damage and penetration (from 25mm to 20mm) as well as the armor thickness needed to actually deal damage[/*][*]K21 XC-8: Improved this vehicle’s acceleration and braking properties[/*][*]M50 Ontos: The amount of smoke charges increased from 4 to 8, the vehicle now has a two-round smoke shell magazine with 4 second reload time and the reload time of this entire magazine is 40 seconds[/*][*]PL-01: Improved this vehicle’s acceleration and braking properties[/*][*]T-15 Armata: fixed the model of its destroyed missile launchers[/*][*]Moscow Calling Special Operation 1: Fixed the issue that some bot kills to sometimes not count correctly for the purpose of objective completion[/*][*]Moscow Calling Special Operation 1: The enemy PL-01 now appears with correct “stealth” camouflage[/*][*]Moscow map: grass is now rendered correctly[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Commander progress acceleration button was sometimes appearing for Premium commanders with fixed skills[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the Garage music would play over a running video in the game[/*][*]Fixed a number of small UI issues[/*][*]Fixed a number of small vehicle visual model issues[/*][*]Fixed some issues that caused the game to crash[/*][*]Added a number of Bastille Day event assets[/*][/list]

notes.title: Moscow Calling: What’s Available
notes.content:
Commanders!

The latest Moscow Season update brought a number of interesting activities that you can participate in to obtain some rather unique visual rewards and now’s the right time to take a look at what you can actually do in Armored Warfare to obtain them.

Please note that, for this article, we’ll exclude the Battle Path content and will focus on items generally available to anyone.

[h1]Special Operations[/h1]

Of the four Moscow Calling Special Operation missions that we promised, two missions are currently available with the other two coming this week and in the second half of July respectively. Aside from a number of interesting achievement rewards, these Special Operations give you the opportunity to obtain special [b]Capital camouflage[/b] for all environments:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/capital_camo.jpg[/img]

To obtain these camouflages, one has to complete the following achievements:
[list][*]Woodland version: Vehicles in Moscow achievement, currently available for completing the two initially available Special Operations missions in every vehicle class in the game (including SPGs)[/*][*]Winter version: Quick Robbery achievement (will only become available with the third Moscow Calling mission)[/*][*]Desert version: Emergency Service achievement (will only become available with the fourth Moscow Calling mission)[/*][/list]
Keep an eye out for the other two when the missions become available! There are, of course, other Moscow Calling achievements that you can complete for a number of other prizes – check out the Moscow Calling section of your Achievements tab in the Dossier window.

[h1]Contract Missions Campaign[/h1]

The launch of the Moscow Calling season marked the activation of a new Contract campaign with different rules compared to the previous one. Instead of having to collect blueprint pieces for a reward tank from Loot Crates, you can now finish the initial contract to obtain the main prize directly – this time, it’s the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-zubr-psp][b]ZUBR PSP[/b][/url] Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer.

Once this Tank Destroyer appears in your Garage, you can do two things with it (apart from playing, of course):
[list][*]Select one of the two available configurations (a gun turret or a missile one)[/*][*]Unlock the special Enforcer skin for 2.500 Gold in the Customization window[/*][/list]
The latter option is quite unique in the sense that it features a distinctive “police” look, inspired by the Russian Guard (Rosgvardia) units.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/zubr_skin.jpg[/img]

Once the ZUBR PSP contract is completed, another contract with the same conditions becomes available but, this time, with a different reward – the [b]Moscow Supply Crate.[/b] This crate is a special seasonal reward that features several interesting items. For one, it always drops a Tier 6 to Tier 8 Premium vehicle as well as a visual customization options.

The permanent Premium vehicles that drop from this crate include (amongst many others), the Type 90 MBT, Challenger 1 Falcon, BMPT Prototype, Sabre and others vehicles that you had the opportunity to obtain in the past.

There are, however, some unique visual customization items in it as well. The most distinctive is the [b]Beast[/b] series for the following vehicles:
[list][*]Challenger 2 ATDU[/*][*]Centauro 120[/*][*]Merkava Mk.3D BAZ[/*][*]VBL INGWE[/*][*]AMX-13 DCA[/*][/list]
 
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/beast_skin_challenger.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/beast_skin_centauro.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/beast_skin_merkava.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/beast_skin_vbl.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/beast_skin_amx.jpg[/img]

Other visual customization options that drop from this crate include:
[list][*]Moscow Calling camouflage called Ruins[/*][*]Black Sea Incursion camouflage called Kazbek[/*][*]Arabian Nights camouflage called Euphrates[/*][*]Other standard skins[/*][/list]
 
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/ruins_camo.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/kazbek_camo.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/euphrates_camojpg.jpg[/img]

Please note that these items will appear in your inventory, Goods section (at the end).

And last but not least, there is a special achievement called Moscow Conquest for completing the Moscow Contract one, two, three or four times to obtain unique decals and, for the last stage, also a special player avatar.

[h1]Weekly Events[/h1]

The Weekly Events are now available during weekends. Currently, these consist of:
[list][*]Caribbean Crisis re-run (allowing you to complete Caribbean Crisis achievements)[/*][*]Black Sea Incursion re-run (allowing you to complete Black Sea Incursion achievements)[/*][*]War Games Labyrinth mode (allowing you to obtain special War Games Loot Crates)[/*][/list]
War Games Loot Crates always drop the following items (all of them for each crate):
[list][*]500 Bonus Battle Coins for the Age of Rage Battle Path[/*][*]10 Experimental Field Rebuild Kits (normally obtainable only via Battalion activities)[/*][*]Random diamond booster[/*][*]Random 1-day temporary Premium vehicle[/*][/list]
The Weekly Events can be accessed in the HQ, PvE mode (a smaller button above the Moscow Calling Special Operation one). Keep an eye on which event is active for the weekend in order not to miss the opportunity to get your hands on War Games Loot Crates and other goodies!

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]

This is, of course, not the full scale of available activities and items to unlock in the Moscow Calling season. The second half of the French vehicle branch is coming soon and, with it, interesting items such as:
[list][*]New retrofits (both v2 and v3)[/*][*]New Francine De Laroche camouflages[/*][*]Commander Vincent Girard[/*][*]Mastery system[/*][*]Additional ZUBR PSP modules that improve its performance for the amount of Contract Missions completed[/*][/list]
We’ll talk more about those upon their introduction to the game.

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Offer: Independence Day
notes.content:
Commanders!

In celebration of the United States Independence Day, [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/bonuses-us-independence-day][b]along with the other bonuses and a free gift[/b][/url], we’ve prepared several American-themed items for this week:
[list][*]New Independence skin for the M60A2 Tier 5 Main Battle Tank (along with other previously introduced U.S.-themed skins)[/*][*]RDF/LT Tier 6 Premium Light Tank[/*][/list]
The following bundles are available [b]between July 4 and July 11, 2019:[/b]

[h1]Independence skin for M60A2 Starship[/h1]

The [b]Independence[/b] is a new American-themed skin for the M60A2 Starship Tier 5 progression Main Battle Tank, containing several visual elements that are distinctively connected with the United States of America, such as stars and the colors red, white and blue. A must-have for every American patriot out there!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_3.jpg[/img]

Please note that this bundle does not contain the M60A2 Starship Tier 5 MBT, only the skin itself. You have to own the M60A2 Starship to use it. The skin alone is available in our [url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][b]Web Shop[/b][/url] for Gold as well as on [url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][b]MyLoot[/b][/url], but we’ve also prepared several MyLoot-exclusive bundles:

[b]Improved Bundle[/b] with 30% discount, containing:
[list][*]Independence skin for M60A2 Starship[/*][*]8 Gold Loot Crates[/*][*]5 Gold Battlefield Glory 12-hour Boost tokens[/*][*]American Hat decal (FREE BONUS)[/*][/list]
[b]Prime Bundle[/b] with 39% discount, containing:

The RDF/LT designation stands for Rapid Deployment Force Light Tank. Several prototypes were built for the U.S. armed forces evaluations with various guns. You can read more about its development in [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/vehicles-focus-rdflt][b]a dedicated article.[/b][/url]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Economy Issues in Update 0.29
notes.content:
Commanders!

As you know, we’ve recently launched Update 0.29 and, with it, the Moscow Calling season along with the features and changes that we’ve promised.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/main_img_2_notxt_0.jpg[/img]

One of the most important changes was the adjustments to the game’s Credit economy. We’ve described our goals in our earlier [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-economy-improvements][b]developer article[/b][/url] but, in short, the changes focused on two things:
[list][*]Major PvP Credit income improvement[/*][*]PvE Credit income improvement combined with a reward logic overhaul (shifting most income from simply killing AI vehicles to actually completing mission objectives)[/*][/list]
However, an unexpected thing happened upon the launch of Update 0.29. Players in fact started seeing much lower income in PvE – it was reduced by approximately 30 percent across the board compared to the Update 0.28 state. This change was discovered almost immediately thanks to your feedback, although it took some time to analyze what exactly caused this problem.

The root of the issue turned out to be the complexity of economic calculations despite several rounds of testing and adjustments, including the PTS stage. Naturally, it was not our intention to reduce player income – quite the opposite and we immediately took steps to remedy it.

As an emergency measure, we activated 100 percent Credit income bonus that will stay active until the issue is resolved.

[b]But that is, of course not a real solution. We already have a hotfix prepared that will introduce the following changes:[/b]
[list][*]40% bonus to overall PvE Credit income[/*][*]50% bonus to overall PvP Credit income[/*][*]45% bonus to Global Operations Credit income in the form of 400% increase of the basic Credit reward for capture points in the mode[/*][*]Battle-hardened status Credit income bonus increase (from 25% to 50%)[/*][*]Premium vehicle Credit income bonus increase (from 50% to 100%)[/*][/list]
The 100% Credit income bonus for Premium Time will, of course, remain implemented.

In combination with the already introduced mechanics, these changes should correct most of the issues currently plaguing the game economy and bring the game to the state described by the abovementioned developer article. We will, of course, continue to monitor the situation and will act accordingly if further tweaks are needed.

[b]Thank you for your patience and see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: The Age of Rage Battle Path is now available!
notes.content:
Commanders!

The wait is finally over – the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-battle-path-age-rage][b]Age of Rage Battle Path[/b][/url] campaign starts today. It’s high time you show the world what real rage against the machine looks like!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x-3qWRt6V5g

This three-month-long anarchist-themed campaign offers you the opportunity to get your hands on three very special reward vehicles, including the coveted [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-object-490][b]Object 490[/b][/url] Tier 10 Premium MBT, but other valuable prizes are also available, including Commander [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-commander-ofelia-kitescu][b]Ophelia Kitescu[/b][/url], skins, decals and much more. You can find more information about the campaign in the Frequently Asked Questions section below.

In order to join the Battle Path campaign, please enter the game and click on the Age of Rage icon on the upper bar.

From there, you can simply purchase the Battle Path access (either for currency or for Gold).

The following options are available:

[b]Anarchist Pack[/b], containing:
[list][*]Battle Path access[/*][*]Player title: “Mutineer”[/*][*]Decal: “Clown Mask”[/*][/list]
 
[b]Age of Rage Prize Gallery[/b]
 

Object 490:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1110.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1110_1.jpg[/img]

Object 490 Devastator skin:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1111.jpg[/img]

BWP-2000:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1111_1.jpg[/img]

M50 Ontos:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1111_2.jpg[/img]

Rage skins:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1112.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1113.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1113_1.jpg[/img]

Chaos camouflage:

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1114.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1114_1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190627_1115_0.jpg[/img]


Additionally, for the players who want to start with an extra boost, we have the following bundle available:

[b]Rioter Pack[/b], containing:
[list][*]Battle Path access[/*][*]Player title: “Mutineer”[/*][*]Decal: “Clown Mask”[/*][*]Battle Coins: 40.000 (enough to boost your progress to Level 19)[/*][/list]
Both options are also available on [url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][b]MyLoot[/b][/url] and in our [url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][b]Web Shop[/b][/url].

Please note that there might be a delay of up to 10 minutes between the purchase and the access to the event.

[b]Frequently Asked Questions (Click to Open)[/b]

[b]How does it all work?[/b]

Simply put, you earn Battle Coins by completing missions and then spend them to raise your Battle Path level while earning Battle Path Premium vehicles, camouflages, player avatars, skins, decals and other goodies, including a reward tank with Premium status, the Tier 10 Object 490 MBT. You can also get other Premium vehicles as well as two Object 490 skins.

[b]What do I have to do?[/b]

The Battle Path campaign is divided into four paths (mission chains), each with its set of many missions. But, more importantly, there are the new Repeatable Battle Coins missions available each day, called:
[list][*]Piece of Cake[/*][*]Grinding[/*][*]Need More Coins[/*][/list]
By completing the missions, you will receive Battle Coins, which are used to increase your level. Repeatable Battle Coin missions are your most important source of Battle Coins.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190620_1417.jpg[/img]

Other rewards for completing missions include exclusive Rage skins (for Centauro 105, FV510 Warrior, T-90), Gold, various Loot Crates, Boosters, Credits and Commander [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-commander-ofelia-kitescu][b]Ophelia Kitescu[/b][/url].

[b]How many levels are there and why should I care?[/b]

There are 60 levels in total – 50 standard levels and 10 bonus ones for hardcore players. For reaching Level 50, you will receive an exclusive reward tank with Premium status, the Tier 10 Object 490 along with the “Destroyer” skin for it. Levels 51 to 60 award special Elite Supply Crates.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190620_1417.jpg[/img]

For reaching the ultimate Level 60, you will receive another skin for the Object 490 called “Devastator” as well as an Age of Rage flag. Along with these prizes, various other rewards await you for every level you reach. Their list can be found on the Battle Path progress bar in the game.

[b]What are Elite Supply Crates?[/b]

Elite Supply Crates are available for reaching Battle Path Levels 51-60. They cannot be obtained outside of a Battle Path and contain guaranteed Tier 6 or higher Premium vehicle drops (including older Battle Path vehicles), rare commanders (including Cortez and Alisa Korhonen) as well as a large amount of Battle Coins for the Battle Path that will come after the Age of Rage – this way, after obtaining the Object 490, you can not only obtain otherwise unavailable items, but also prepare for the future. These Battle Coins are, however, redeemable even in the Age of Rage Battle Path.

[b]How can I start a mission chain (path)?[/b]

In order to start a mission chain, you need a pass. You will receive a free pass on Level 1, 7 and 12 – you decide which chain you wish to unlock and when. In order to unlock the access to the fourth chain (the “Madness” missions), you need to complete all the three previous chains first.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190620_1418.jpg[/img]

[b]What are the Battle Coins?[/b]

The Battle Coins are a unique currency, required to advance through Battle Path levels. You can also spend Battle Coins on completing difficult missions without having to actually complete their requirements in the game. On the Battle Path screen, you can see your Battle Coin balance in the upper right corner.

[b]How can I obtain Battle Coins?[/b]

There are several ways of obtaining them:
[list][*]By completing Repeatable Battle Coins missions[/*][*]By completing missions from one of the four mission chains – almost each completed mission will award you with a certain amount of Battle Coins[/*][*]By purchasing them or winning them in an official Armored Warfare event[/*][*]By just playing – it’s worth noting that obtaining them is restricted to Tier 3 vehicles or higher and to the higher difficulty setting in PvE[/*][/list]
It’s worth noting that:
[list][*]Special Battle Coin boosters can be obtained for Repeatable Battle Coin missions and for Battle Path level progression, increasing your Battle Coin income for two hours by 900 percent (these can also be saved for future Battle Paths)[/*][*]We have implemented a new queue compensation mechanism for players who wait a bit too long in queues. Long waits will be compensated by increased Battle Coin income[/*][*]You will get Battle Coins for playing even without Battle Path access[/*][/list]
The amount of Battle Coins for playing is calculated as such:

For each minute you spend alive in battle (with the exclusion of downtime such as waiting for a respawn), you will receive 1 to 3 Battle Coins in PvE and 2 to 4 in PvP (including Global Operations). Furthermore, winning increases this income by 25 percent in PvE (including Special Operations) and by 50 percent in PvP and GLOPS. Additionally, the best players of the team by Experience obtained will receive an additional bonus – extra 4 Battle Coins for being first in PvE or Spec Ops, extra 5 Battle Coins for ending up in Top 3 in PvP and, last but not least, extra 10 Battle Coins for ending up in Top 3 in GLOPS match.

[b]How long will the campaign be available?[/b]

The Battle Path missions will be available for the duration of 3 months. The remaining time can be seen in the Battle Path window in the game.

[b]What unique prizes can I look forward to for participating in the Battle Path?[/b]

The Battle Path level prizes include:
[list][*][url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-m50-ontos][b]M50 Ontos[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-bwp-2000][b]BWP-2000[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-object-490][b]Object 490[/b][/url][/*][/list]
Battle Path mission rewards include:
[list][*]Centauro 105 Rage skin[/*][*]FV510 Warrior Rage skin[/*][*]T-90 Rage skin[/*][*]Commander [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-commander-ofelia-kitescu][b]Ophelia Kitescu[/b][/url][/*][/list]
[b]How do I unlock a mission chain (Path)?[/b]

You can unlock it by using a pass. A pass can be obtained by reaching Level 1, 7 and 12 respectively.

[b]Can I complete the missions within a chain in any order?[/b]

No. You need to complete them in the order specified by each chain, one after another. It is, however, possible to complete a mission by spending extra Battle Coins. You can see which mission is currently active by visiting the Mission tab of the Battle Path window. The completed missions are marked with a green ticker and the missions that are yet to be unlocked are marked with a lock icon.

[b]How many Battle Coins does unlocking each level cost?[/b]

Advancing to another level costs 50 to 1250 Battle Coins for Levels 1-9, 3300 Battle Coins for levels 10-50 and 32500 for bonus levels 51-60.

[b]Can I see the progress of my missions in the game?[/b]

Yes, in the Battle Path window.

[b]Can I complete more missions at the same time, or the next one only starts after the previous one is finished?[/b]

The next one only starts after the previous one is finished. You need to pick up your mission reward manually in the Battle Path window in order to activate the next mission. However, if you earn more than one pass and unlock multiple chains at the same time, it is theoretically possible to have up to three missions active simultaneously and to complete them all in one battle (if their requirements do not prohibit you from doing so).

[b]How do I know what vehicles to use and what modes to enter when completing a mission?[/b]

Mission requirements are stated in each mission’s description, although no missions can be completed in a Tier 1 or Tier 2 vehicle in PvP or in PvE Easy mode. “Madness” chain missions can only be completed in a Tier 9 or Tier 10 vehicle.

[b]Do I also need a pass for the Madness mission chain?[/b]

No, it is unlocked automatically once you complete all three previous Paths (mission chains).

[b]When do I receive a prize that I win, for example by advancing by a level?[/b]

You will receive it automatically, within 30 minutes of you receiving it.

[b]If I didn’t receive the reward I won fair and square, what do I do?[/b]

Please contact our support service.

[b]I’ve seen a reference to the Age of Rage crates. Can you tell me more about them?[/b]

The Age of Rage Loot Crates will be obtainable in the future in exchange for surplus Battle Coins. They will work basically the same as the Wasteland Loot Crates from the last Battle Path. They will include a Battle Path vehicle, the M-95 Degman MBT – either directly or its blueprints.

The main difference is that these Loot Crates will no longer drop temporary Premium vehicles and that, instead of being able to sell them for Gold, you’ll be able to sell their contents for Battle Coins.

[b]Enjoy the event and see you on the battlefield![/b]

This three-month-long anarchist-themed campaign offers you the opportunity to get your hands on three very special reward vehicles, including the coveted Object 490 Tier 10 Premium MBT, but other valuable prizes are also available, including Commander Ophelia Kitescu, skins, decals and much more.
In order to join the Battle Path campaign, please enter the game and click on the Age of Rage icon on the upper bar.
From there, you can simply purchase the Battle Path access (either for currency or for Gold).

Decal: “Clown Mask”
Battle Coins: 40.000 (enough to boost your progress to Level 19)

notes.title: The Moscow Calling season is now available!
notes.content:
Commanders!

We are happy to announce that the European-themed [b]Moscow Calling[/b] season is now available!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0H98B3RaERQ

From new Special Operations to fixes and a brand-new Garage, this season has it all. Here’s what’s new in Update 0.29:

 
[h1]New Special Operation[/h1]
 

During your adventures in the desert and in the far north, you’ve dealt a crippling blow to Clayburn Industries. With the main driving force behind its expansion, CEO Sebastian Grimm, out of the picture, its resistance crumbles everywhere as, all around the world, its assets are being seized by the ISD. A great summit is called to Moscow to broker peace with the largest corporations on the planet once and for all and you, as a key actor of the events of the last two years, are invited...

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/04_3.jpg[/img]

Another story arc begins with the conclusion of Magnus Holter’s campaign with his quest for vengeance complete during the final mission of the Arabian Nights season. A new enemy has emerged from the shadows and you’re in for the fight of your lives.

Four new missions as well as a number of epic achievements and customization options (including decals, avatars and a new camouflage set) await you in this perhaps the most epic Armored Warfare experience to date.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/so1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/so2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/so3_1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/so4_1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Moscow PvP Map[/h1]
 

A new large urban PvP map awaits you, based on one of the largest boulevards in Moscow. No-one sleeps on this rainy night as various armored vehicles slug it out in pale streetlight under the gaze of the rich and privileged watching the action below from their high-rise apartments surrounding the area.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0184.jpg[/img]

Despite its city setting, the map is fairly open with wide streets offering a lot of room to maneuver. Some areas such as tunnels and various construction sites do, however, provide plenty of cover, making the map suitable for all kinds of vehicles.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0192_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0185_2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0186_1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0193_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0199_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0202_0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0204_1.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]Endgame[/h1]
 

One of the main focuses for this season is giving the players more things to do. Apart from the upcoming Battle Path campaign, we’re working on a number of activities and improvements, such as:
[list][*]War Games mode, a special training exercise on the PvE map[/*][*]New Contract Missions with improved rewards, including the ZUBR PSP Tier 7 Premium Tank Destroyer[/*][/list]
You can read more about these features in [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/developer-diary-endgame-and-activities][b]our article.[/b][/url] For more details, please also visit the patchnotes below. Please note that:
[list][*]The War Games mode will become available approximately two weeks after the launch of this Update, alternating with the old Special Operations during weekends[/*][*]The Mastery system and Level 3 retrofits, also described in the article, will also arrive during the Moscow Calling season, but at a later date[/*][/list]
[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0109_6.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]Economy Improvements[/h1]
 

We’ve prepared a number of changes for both the PvE and PvP modes, aimed at increasing your income across the board. We have tweaked the reward rules significantly as well – in PvE, it’s now much more important to complete the objectives of each mission rather than to just kill everything in sight – completing objectives will grant you progressively larger rewards as you advance through missions. You can read more about them in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-economy-improvements][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/screenshot0342_0.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we’ve prepared two changes for your convenience and based on your feedback:
[list][*]Premium Time now grants 100 percent Credit income instead of the earlier 50 percent[/*][*]K1A1 upgrade modules can now be purchased directly for Experience in order to upgrade your vehicle properly[/*][/list]
 
[h1]Gameplay Mechanics Improvements[/h1]
 

And last but most definitely not least, we’ll be introducing a very large number of various bug fixes and mechanics enhancements. These include:
[list][*]Commander progression improvements[/*][*]Ricochet mechanic improvements[/*][*]New daily bonuses[/*][*]Improved wheeled vehicle steering[/*][*]Improved Armor Viewer accuracy[/*][/list]
And many others. For more details, please visit the Moscow Calling patchnotes below.

 
[b][u]List of Moscow Calling changes[/u][/b]
 

 
[b][u]Gameplay Mechanisms[/u][/b]
 

[b]New Special Operation[/b]

Four epic Special Operation missions await you, starting with a peace summit that takes place in the Russian capital of Moscow. These will, of course, come with new achievements:
[list][*]Moscow Resident (four stages to this one)[/*][*]No Slowing Down[/*][*]Magnus Defense[/*][*]Tower Defense[/*][*]Bomber[/*][*]Quick Robbery[/*][*]Not a Problem[/*][*]Before They React[/*][*]Emergency Service[/*][/list]
A secret achievement will be present as well along with some proper rewards for your feats, which include camouflages and more.

[b]War Games[/b]

We are introducing a series of new PvE modes that will challenge your skill and the ability of your group to work as a team, starting with Labyrinth. In this mode, you will race against time to capture randomly appearing bases – but that's just the beginning. In the Moscow Calling season, it will appear periodically along with older Special Operations. You can read more about the mode in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/developer-diary-endgame-and-activities][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[b]Improved Visuals[/b]

A number of visual effects were overhauled to look significantly better. These include:
[list][*]Penetrations, non-penetrations and ricochets[/*][*]Vehicle interaction with stone, concrete, metallic and wooden objects[/*][*]Tracer rounds[/*][*]Mud and dust from beneath the wheels and tracks[/*][*]Exhaust smoke[/*][*]Fuel and ammunition fires[/*][/list]
And, last but not least, we've significantly improved the visual quality of Garage models (including those in the SD client).

[b]Economy Improvements[/b]

We've prepared a number of reward changes for both PvP and PvE – the mechanics behind them are described in a [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-economy-improvements][b]dedicated article[/b][/url] but the important part is – you'll earn more.

[b]Commander Improvements[/b]

We are improving the Commander system by making it possible to train all your commanders to Rank 15 along with some other changes such as the ability to purchase a Commander Experience bundle for Gold or the ability to level up your Commanders directly for Reputation above Rank 10. You can read more about the improvements in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-commander-progression-improvements][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[b]New Player Daily Bonus[/b]

New players have now the option to purchase a special item bundle intended to make the start of their mercenary career even more comfortable. Additionally, for a month, the owners of this bundle will receive daily gifts.

[b]Updated Contract Campaign[/b]

We added a new series of contracts and missions with the main prize being the ZUBR PSP Tier 8 Premium Tank Destroyer. You can read more about the campaign in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/developer-diary-endgame-and-activities][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

As for the ZUBR, you can learn more about it in [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-zubr-psp][b]our preview.[/b][/url]

[b]ATGM Improvements[/b]

We've changed the way ATGMs get launched. Before, upon launch, they "slowed down" and only gradually accelerated to their full speed. Now, they accelerate quicker and feel more natural.

Additionally, the maximum velocity of gun-launched ATGMs was increased to 300-320 m/s and some TOW missiles received an upgrade in agility and velocity (this change concerns the following vehicles: M1134, M2A3 Bradley, ZBL-08).

[b]HE and HEAT Impact Overhaul[/b]

We've overhauled the way HE and HEAT shells interact with armor at extreme angles. They do no longer automatically detonate when the impact angle is above 85 degrees even when the armor is really thin (overmatch rules do no longer apply) with the chance to not detonate increasing from 87 degrees onwards to approximately 50 percent. As a result:
[list][*]Firing these shells at heavily armored tanks from extreme angles will not work even with the strongest projectiles[/*][*]Lightly armored targets (with roughly 20-40mm of armor or less, the value can depend on a projectile) will still be susceptible to ATGMs even at extreme angles[/*][/list]
However, firing at anything at extreme angles (87 degrees or more) is now quite unreliable with a chance of the shell not detonating and is definitely not encouraged.

[b]Ricochet Overhaul[/b]

We've overhauled the way ricochets work – as a result, thin armor will ricochet shells off less often and thick armor will ricochet them more often.

Furthermore, earlier on, ricochets would happen from 70 degrees (0 percent chance) to 72 degrees (100 percent chance) – now, they will happen from 67 degrees to 73 degrees for APFSDS shells that still nominally have the ricochet value of 70 degrees. As an example – when an APFSDS shell standard impacts armor (not thin enough to trigger the overmatch mechanic but thin enough to guarantee penetration) under the angle of 71.5 degrees, the chance to ricochet will be:

Ricochet Chance = (71.5-67)/6 = 75 percent (ergo, the chance to penetrate is actually 25 percent)

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the reverse steering issue (yes, we had to put this one first, that's how important it is)[/*][*]Premium Account credit income bonus is increased from 50 percent to 100 percent[/*][*]Killing friendly players who are marked as team killers no longer carries any penalty – it also does not cause your team to lose points in Global Operations[/*][*]Added a new set of Pirate flags[/*][*]Players who wait in a queue for a longer time will receive a special bonus to compensate for the waiting time[/*][*]Assist kill now only counts for the player who dealt the most damage towards the destroyed target instead of the previous top three[/*][*]Fixed an Armor Inspector issue where penetration chance was on multiple occasions not displayed correctly – the color now corresponds to the actual chance to penetrate[/*][*]The Armor Inspector ricochet value is also displayed correctly now[/*][*]The Ioannis Sanna commander skills that increase the chance to set enemy vehicles on fire now work correctly[/*][*]Battalion Contract Missions that require you to accumulate Experience for killing, damage and fire support had their requirements changed to spotting damage dealing, fire support or kills directly (with an additional multiplier when playing against other players in PvP)[/*][*]Improved the prize pool for the Battalion Contracts feature – apart from receiving a temporary version of a Hades vehicle, eligible players will now also receive a blueprint part for its permanent version, 10 Experimental Field Kit PvE consumables and three special 12-hour boost tokens that prevent players from losing one rank in Ranked Battles – see the PvP section of patchnotes for more details[/*][*]Battalion Contracts now have a bonus available that increases the contract progress for completing a Heroic Mission (regardless of in which mode) ten times. This bonus is used for up to 20 mission completions per week, but the basic contract progress for completing a Heroic Mission was reduced from 40 to 4 points[/*][*]Battalion Contract Mission cooldown now starts from receiving the missions rather than from completing it[/*][*]You can now purchase a 12-hour Platinum quality booster token in the Garage for 300 Gold along with some other boosters as well[/*][*]Engine revving sound can now be heard even in the first person mode[/*][*]Removed the artificial 30 FPS inactive window cap that was applied whenever the game window was not active and not minimized at the same time[/*][*]Tier 1 and Tier 2 PvP battles no longer count for the purposes of Dossier statistics[/*][*]Improved the mechanics behind GPU autodetection and recommended settings to better tune your client to your PC's specifications[/*][*]Improved a number of small graphics elements[/*][/list]
 
[b][u]Vehicles[/u][/b]
 

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]Reduced the kinetic shell penetration randomization value for the Chinese Type-series tanks and the VT-4 from the incorrect 15 percent to the correct value of 10 percent[/*][*]The entire BMPT series suffered from an issue where the gun depression and elevation values in the first person (sniper) mode were different from those in the third person mode – this issue was fixed[/*][*]Challenger 1 Fionn and Object 279 Banner Bearer can no longer use the Flag feature[/*][*]The hull traverse speed of a number of vehicles did not correspond to their Garage value – this issue was now corrected[/*][*]Added a new sound effect when using the Hydraulic Suspension active ability[/*][*]Active Ability sounds work now correctly on the Alabino Proving Grounds map[/*][*]Several vehicles (most notably the Centauro series) now have better crew hatch armor[/*][*]Wheeled vehicles now tend to slide less in reverse[/*][*]Fixed the issue where unlocked Tier 9 tokens appeared incorrectly on Tier 2 vehicles[/*][/list]
[b]Abrams AGDS[/b]
[list][*]Replaced the Engine Overdrive active ability with one called Radar, working roughly the same as the one on the AMX-13 DCA – by activating your fire control radar, you will enhance your viewrange and the ability to detect targets even when they are hiding behind foliage, but at the cost of your own camouflage (the radar is also now animated)[/*][*]Increased the vehicle's viewrange by 5 meters[/*][/list]
[b]AFT-10[/b]
[list][*]Added an animation for the elevation and depression of the vehicle's optics module[/*][/list]
[b]Altay[/b]
[list][*]HEAT shell damage is now unified with that of the Leopard 2A6 MBT[/*][/list]
[b]AMX-10 PAC 90[/b]
[list][*]Changed the turret hatch armor – now, these do not receive damage from APFSDS shells but HE shells do full damage when they hit them[/*][/list]
[b]AMX-13 DCA[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the activated radar sound in the first person (sniper) mode[/*][/list]
[b]AMX-30B2 Brenus[/b]
[list][*]Improved the amount of kinetic shells carried from 20 to 27[/*][/list]
[b]Ariete[/b]
[list][*]DM12A1 HEAT shell damage improved to 575 to match its performance on the Leopard vehicle series[/*][*]Fixed an issue where targeting certain sections of hull side armor could make the penetration indicator appear grey instead of its correct color[/*][/list]
[b]ASCOD LT[/b]
[list][*]Overhauled the Upgrade window – both turrets now have their corresponding shells appear correctly[/*][/list]
[b]BM Oplot[/b]
[list][*]The shell impact visual effect now appears correctly on the vehicle's side plate instead of under it[/*][/list]
[b]BMD-2[/b]
[list][*]Shells no longer pass through the ATGM launcher – however, hitting it will not deal any damage to the vehicle[/*][*]Improved the visual quality of this vehicle (same goes for BMD-2M)[/*][/list]
[b]C13 TUA[/b]
[list][*]The duration of the reload sound now corresponds to the actual reloading animation[/*][/list]
[b]Centauro 105[/b]
[list][*]Improved the appearance of several visual elements[/*][*]The rear turret mesh now acts as cage armor[/*][/list]
[b]Centauro 120[/b]
[list][*]Improved the appearance of several visual elements[/*][*]The rear turret mesh now acts as cage armor[/*][/list]
[b]Challenger 1[/b]
[list][*]Improved this vehicle's model quality[/*][/list]
[b]Challenger 1 Falcon[/b]
[list][*]DM12A1 HEAT shell damage improved to 575 to match its performance on the Leopard vehicle series[/*][*]Improved this vehicle's model quality[/*][/list]
[b]Challenger 2 ATDU[/b]
[list][*]Improved this vehicle's model quality[/*][*]Fixed the vehicle's collision model to avoid component clipping[/*][/list]
[b]IS-7[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the inconsistent frontal gun depression – the gun is now always able to depress to at least -6 degrees as long as it's within 90 degrees to each side of the vehicle's axis[/*][/list]
[b]K1A1[/b]
[list][*]It is now possible to unlock this tank's upgrade modules for Experience. Surplus upgrade blueprint parts can be sold for Gold. Players who didn't manage to get their hands on all upgrades during the previous season will be able to do so for Experience.[/*][/list]
[b]Kornet-EM[/b]

notes.title: Offer: Door into Summer
notes.content:
Commanders!

Summer is almost upon us and, to celebrate the occasion, we’ve prepared [b]two hot skins as well as six historical summer camouflages.[/b]

The following bundles are available [b]between June 20 and June 27, 2019:[/b]

 
[h1]New Skins – Bad Bee and Fahrenheit[/h1]
 

Two new skins are now available on MyLoot – one for the M1128 Stryker Tier 8 progression Tank Destroyer and one for the Magach 6B Tier 5 progression Main Battle Tank.

[b]Bad Bee[/b] is special summer-themed skin for the Stryker. Combining colors yellow, black and the hexagonal pattern that is typically associated with bees, this striking paint job warns all potential predators that this angry vehicle is not to be messed with. Much like the animal that served as an inspiration for the livery, the Stryker is very useful and sure can sting!

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_2.jpg[/img]

[b]Fahrenheit[/b], on the other hand, clads your Magach 6B in a breathtaking fiery pattern that Ioannis Sanna would definitely get very excited about. The name comes, apart from the painted flames, from the large yellow number 451 used in the pattern – 451 degrees of Fahrenheit is the temperature that sets paper ablaze. So wake up, commanders, you’ve got a city to burn!

 
[url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/429x154.png[/img][/url]
 

 
[h1]Camouflages[/h1]
 

We’ve also prepared six [b]historical camouflages[/b] for you that are based on real life Mediterranean countries’ patterns – two Greek ones, two Cypriot ones and two from Italy. You can read more about them in our [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/historical-camouflages-mediterranean][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

These camouflages are available:
[list][*]In our [url=https://aw.my.com/web-shop][b]Web Shop[/b][/url] for Gold[/*][*]On [url=https://loot.my.com/shop/18/][b]MyLoot[/b][/url] for standard currency[/*][/list]
Additionally, all six camouflages are available together on MyLoot with a massive discount!

Greek Camouflage 1

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_greek2.jpg[/img]

Greek Camouflage 2

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_greek1.jpg[/img]

Cypriot Camouflage 1

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_cyprus2.jpg[/img]

Cypriot Camouflage 2

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_cyprus1.jpg[/img]

Italian Camouflage 1

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_italy1.jpg[/img]

Italian Camouflage 2

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/1920_1080_sep_italy2.jpg[/img]

Please note that each of these camouflages can be installed on any vehicle that has the camouflage customization feature available (any vehicle with the exception of vehicles with permanent skins) and that each of these camouflages can be used in all three environments.

 
[h1]Premium Vehicles[/h1]
 

And last but not least, we’ve prepared special discounts, mid-sized bundles and large bundles for the [b]Object 187[/b] Tier 7 Premium Main Battle Tank.

The Object 187 was a Soviet era program, developed to improve upon the excellent but ageing T-72 Main Battle Tank. Several prototypes were built, featuring a number of advanced elements compared to the older Soviet tanks, such as the new long 125mm smoothbore gun with a typical muzzle brake. The result was an excellent MBT that was, however, never mass-produced due to the 1990s Russian military budget cuts – the Russian army chose a less advanced but cheaper T-90 instead. You can learn more about it in our [url=https://aw.my.com/gb/news/general/development-object-187][b]dedicated article.[/b][/url]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/day_6_object_187.jpg[/img]

In Armored Warfare, the Object 187 is a typical Russian style Main Battle Tank – it’s suitable for an aggressive play style and is a good choice for the players who prefer to take on their opponents at close ranges.

Apart from the discounted standalone offer, it is available in the following bundles:

notes.title: Developer Update: Moscow Calling, Age of Rage, Leclerc and Beyond
notes.content:
Commanders!

Today, we’d like to tell you a bit more about the plans for this summer. As you already know, we are working three big chunks of content that will be available in the near future – the Moscow Calling season, the Age of Rage Battle Path campaign and the rest of Francine De Laroche’s vehicle line featuring the long-awaited Leclerc MBTs. All three items will be available in the near future.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190603_1106_2.jpg[/img]

The first to come will be the launch of the Moscow Calling season. Unlike Arabian Nights, this season will consist of only one major content update, Update 0.29. We’ve unveiled the content of this season in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/preview-moscow-calling][b]preview article[/b][/url] and a Public Test Server session with this update is [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/029-pts-now-available][b]currently available[/b][/url] along with the full list of changes. If all goes well, we’d like to launch the season on [b]June 25, 2019[/b] but, as always, this might change pending on your feedback.

As you might have noticed, the Moscow Calling list of contents does not contain the Age of Rage Battle Path. In order to provide you with a steady flow of things to do, we’ve decided to formally disconnect the launch of a new season with Battle Path campaigns. In other words, Battle Path campaigns will appear either alongside new seasons or independently between them. In this case, we’d like to launch the Age of Rage Battle Path shortly after the beginning of the new season. Currently, that date is set on [b]June 27, 2019[/b] although, since we are currently focusing on getting the new season out there, there may be some delays despite our best efforts.

And, last but not least, there’s the matter of the rest of Francine De Laroche’s Leclerc line that includes the following vehicles:
[list][*]Leclerc Prototype Tier 7 Main Battle Tank ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-char-leclerc-prototype][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][*]VCAC Mephisto Tier 8 Tank Destroyer ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-vcac-mephisto][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][*]Al-Hussein Tier 8 Main Battle Tank ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-al-hussein][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][*]Leclerc Tier 9 Main Battle Tank ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-char-leclerc][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][*]Leclerc T40 Tier 9 Premium Tank Destroyer ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-leclerc-t40][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][*]Leclerc T4 Tier 10 Main Battle Tank ([url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-leclerc-t4][b]learn more[/b][/url])[/*][/list]
Along with the Mastery system, new commander and more retrofits. In order to ensure the best quality possible, we decided to launch this content during a special event that will take place [b]in July.[/b]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/dev_aw_dev_4_190522_1332_3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Historical Camouflages - Mediterranean
notes.content:
Commanders!

Following the success of the Russian historical camouflages, we’ve prepared another set of interesting patterns for you. Summer is here and, with it, sun and holidays – so we thought, why not introduce some patters from the countries of the Mediterranean?

We’ve prepared a set of six camouflages from [b]Greece, Italy and Cyprus[/b] for you to enjoy. As we stated in the last issue, they will not be exactly a hundred percent match to the photographs we are working with due to the fact that we need to make them fit far more vehicles than just one, but we will definitely try to make them as close to the real thing as possible.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/leopard_2a6hel.jpg[/img]

With that being out of the way, let’s take a look at what camouflages will be coming in the near future:

Two [b]Greek camouflages[/b] are based on the pattern often seen on Greek Leopard 2s – be it the older Leopard 2A4 MBTs or the new Leopard 2A6 HEL MBTs. Following the intensive 1998 trials in which the Leopard 2A6 did beat its competitors (including the Challenger 2E, Oplot, Leclerc, T-80U and Abrams), the Hellenic Army acquired some 170 Leopard 2A6 HEL tanks from Germany. These were partially built in Greece as a part of an offset deal and included some smaller modifications compared to their German counterparts, including a link to the Greek battlefield communications and management system.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/greek2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/greek1.jpg[/img]

The deal was closed in 2003 and completed between 2006 and 2009 – interestingly enough, this was the first deal for the Greeks in decades where Greece would receive newly-built weapons instead of military surplus. In 2005, Greece acquired (amongst other things) some 180 older Leopard 2A4s to complement the Leopard 2A6 batch. The Greek Leopard 2s can be usually seen carrying two types of four-color camouflage – a green/black/dark brown/light brown one and a green/black/orange/light grey one. Suitable Armored Warfare vehicles carrying it historically:
[list][*]Leopard 2[/*][*]Leopard 2A6[/*][/list]
Next on the list are two [b]Cypriot camouflages[/b] that were used starting from the 1990s in the Cypriot National Guard. The CNG is an interesting force that uses an odd assortment of armor although, in recent years, there have been making sustained efforts to modernize their forces, including tanks. But, two decades ago, they took what they could afford to replace some of truly obsolete equipment (the Cypriot National Guard was operating T-34 tanks well into the 1980s).

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/cyprus1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/cyprus2.jpg[/img]

This included a purchase of Greek AMX-30B2 tanks in the late 1980s (they were phased out of service in 2018) along with some forty Russian BMP-3s acquired during the “fire sale” years (in this case 1995) when much of the Red Army equipment was available on free market for very low prices. Unlike the AMX-30s, the BMPs are still in active service. The IFV camouflage consists of sand base color with thick green painted stripes and thin white sprayed lines. The MBT camouflage is mostly similar with darker brown base paint. Suitable Armored Warfare vehicles carrying it historically:
[list][*]AMX-30 (a version without the Brenus kit)[/*][*]BMP-3[/*][/list]
And, finally, there are two [b]Italian camouflages.[/b] Unlike the Cypriot and Greek ones, these are only loosely based on real life Italian camouflages that were used during the Second World War, making them somewhat unhistorical, if visually appealing. One consists of red-brown and green stripes on yellow background while the other one features dark green and brown stripes separated by yellow lines.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/italy1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/italy2.jpg[/img]

Like before, these camouflages will be available for all vehicles and environments. We hope you will enjoy them and are hard at work on the next set.

[b]Stay tuned and see you on the battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Developer Diary: Age of Rage Changes
notes.content:
Commanders!

As you know, we are hard at work on a new Battle Path campaign that we are calling “Age of Rage,” which should be hitting the servers come early summer. We’ve recently [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-battle-path-age-rage][b]unveiled the changes[/b][/url] we’ve made compared to the earlier Warlords of the Wasteland campaign and, since then, we’ve made a good bit of progress.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/keyart_1920x1080_0.jpg[/img]

However, as it often happens in games development, some elements of the feature had to be adjusted in order to make the Battle Path campaign as good as we want it to be in order for you to enjoy it and, today, we’d like to tell you more about these changes.

The first and the most important one concerns the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-bvp-m-80a][b]BVP M-80A[/b][/url] Premium AFV, which was supposed to be the initial larger prize of the campaign, available very early on (specifically, Level 10). When the vehicle was unveiled, you voiced your concern about possible balance issues with it. Specifically:
[list][*]When using the ATGM turret, the ability to fire ATGM bursts being overpowered on such a low Tier[/*][*]When using the twin 30mm gun turret, the firepower being way too much[/*][/list]
Initially, we addressed these by changing the vehicle’s Tier to Tier 5, but the initial tests showed that it would need considerably more balancing work in order to make it ready for introduction. That is why, in order not to delay the Battle Path campaign for longer than necessary, we’ve decided to replace it, as a Battle Path prize, with the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-m50-ontos][b]M50 Ontos[/b][/url] Tier 4 Premium Tank Destroyer. The BVP will appear the game when it is ready, but not as a part of the Age of Rage Battle Path campaign.

[img]https://aw.my.com/sites/aw.my.com/files/u183517/05.jpg[/img]

We had a similar issue with the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-m-95-degman][b]M-95 Degman[/b][/url] – this vehicle was unveiled as a Tier 6 MBT, but, given the power of its 120mm gun that already appears in the game on the Challenger Falcon Tier 8 Premium MBT, rather than reduce its power artificially, we decided to move the vehicle to Tier 8 and rebalance it completely. This too will take some time, which is why we decided to switch the roles of the Degman and the [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-bwp-2000][b]BWP-2000[/b][/url], another unveiled Battle Path vehicle.

Upon its reveal, the BWP-2000 feedback was very positive and, in order to make it easier to obtain, a decision was taken to include it in the main Age of Rage progression system.

As such, the BWP-2000 will be a Battle Path level prize while the Degman will, with a delay, appear in the Battle Path Loot Crates (similar in purpose to those with BMPT Model 2017 of the Warlords of the Wasteland campaign). You can read a bit more about the Loot Crates in our [url=https://aw.my.com/us/news/general/development-battle-path-age-rage][b]earlier article[/b][/url] – their exact contents will be unveiled later.

We hope that you will find these changes enjoyable and are looking forward to your feedback. Please note, however, that the feature is still in development and more changes may be coming depending on its balancing process.

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]
